On May 5, 1862, at the **Battle of Puebla** , a smaller, outmatched Mexican force defeated one of the most powerful armies in the world. The French were expected to win.
They didn't.
Because the Mexican army had something stronger:
**Will. Courage. The refusal to back down.**
## A Shared Story in America
Cinco de Mayo has become something uniquely American--a celebration not just of heritage, but of values.
Mexican Americans have helped build this country:
* In business and entrepreneurship
* In military service
* In law, medicine, education, and public life
* In culture that defines modern America

And our histories are intertwined. After the **Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo** , large parts of Mexico became part of the United States.
**This is not just cultural connection.
It is historical reality.**
## 🥊 The Will to Fight
Cinco de Mayo is about something deeper than history.
It's about the fight.
As an ophthalmologist, I've seen that spirit up close. I spent years examining fighters before bouts for the New York State Athletic Commission.
I had the privilege of examining **Oscar De La Hoya** --a champion and a gentleman.
I also examined **Antonio Margarito** after his injury from **Manny Pacquiao** , before his return to fight **Miguel Cotto** at **Madison Square Garden**.
I cleared him after an extensive examination--and with a clear understanding of reality:
**Nothing was going to stop him.**
If he didn't fight in New York, he was going to fight in Las Vegas.
The responsibility wasn't theoretical. It was practical.
**If he was going to step into the ring, it needed to be under the safest possible conditions.**
And I said something then that applies far beyond boxing:
**Having the best hospitals --having strong medical infrastructure--matters.**
Because when people push limits, you want systems in place to protect them.
Margarito lost that fight.
But that's not the point.
**The point is the will to fight --despite the odds, despite the risk, despite the uncertainty.**
## The Meaning of Cinco de Mayo Today
Cinco de Mayo reminds us:
* That underdogs can win
* That courage matters
* That history is shaped by those who step forward

It is not just a Mexican story.
It is an American story.
A story of people who build, sacrifice, and keep going--even when the odds say they shouldn't.
## A Simple Message
Cinco de Mayo is not about the party.
It is about the principle.
**When the odds are against you --fight anyway.
When the outcome is uncertain--step forward anyway.
When others doubt you--prove them wrong anyway.**
That is the story of Puebla.
That is the story of Mexican Americans.
And that is a story that still defines this country today.

On May 5, 1862, at the Battle of Puebla , a smaller, outmatched Mexican force defeated one of the most powerful armies in the world. The French were expected to win. They didn't. Because the Mexican army had something stronger: Will. Courage. The refusal to back down. A Shared Story in America Cinco de Mayo has become something uniquely American--a celebration not just of heritage, but of values. Mexican Americans have helped build this country: In business and entrepreneurship In military service In law, medicine, education, and public life In culture that defines modern America And our histories are intertwined. After the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo , large parts of Mexico became part of the United States. This is not just cultural connection. It is historical reality. 🥊 The Will to Fight Cinco de Mayo is about something deeper than history. It's about the fight. As an ophthalmologist, I've seen that spirit up close. I spent years examining fighters before bouts for the New York State Athletic Commission. I had the privilege of examining Oscar De La Hoya --a champion and a gentleman. I also examined Antonio Margarito after his injury from Manny Pacquiao , before his return to fight Miguel Cotto at Madison Square Garden. I cleared him after an extensive examination--and with a clear understanding of reality: Nothing was going to stop him. If he didn't fight in New York, he was going to fight in Las Vegas. The responsibility wasn't theoretical. It was practical. If he was going to step into the ring, it needed to be under the safest possible conditions. And I said something then that applies far beyond boxing: Having the best hospitals --having strong medical infrastructure--matters. Because when people push limits, you want systems in place to protect them. Margarito lost that fight. But that's not the point. The point is the will to fight --despite the odds, despite the risk, despite the uncertainty. The Meaning of Cinco de Mayo Today Cinco de Mayo reminds us: That underdogs can win That courage matters That history is shaped by those who step forward It is not just a Mexican story. It is an American story. A story of people who build, sacrifice, and keep going--even when the odds say they shouldn't. A Simple Message Cinco de Mayo is not about the party. It is about the principle. When the odds are against you --fight anyway. When the outcome is uncertain--step forward anyway. When others doubt you--prove them wrong anyway. That is the story of Puebla. That is the story of Mexican Americans. And that is a story that still defines this country today. | | ---|---|--- Michael Goldstein for Congress Doctor. Lawyer. Father. body:

| Friends-
Join us on May 12th as we speak out against rising health care costs and demand that Congress cut costs, not care. Together we can raise awareness about Medicaid cuts, rising premiums, and the growing affordability crisis. This event will focus on the possible loss of medical services in this poverty ridden community that is facing the possible closure of a hospital. We will take a look at other issues impacting health care in this Southside Community.

# Stop Taking Our Health Care Event in Franklin VA
---

# Medical Liberty Momentum Is Building
| |
---
| Team TFVC showed up strong across Texas for **four spring conventions in just three weeks** , and we’re excited to share the impact! In Dallas, we learned from some of the most liberty-minded medical professionals in the country at the **Independent Medical Alliance** conference. At the **National Health Federation Conference** , TFVC Outreach Director Carrie Bigford took the stage to share critical outreach strategies, while our volunteers reconnected with longtime allies and welcomed new faces at the TFVC table. Down in Bandera, we connected with countless individuals new to the movement and explored what it looks like to incorporate liberty into every facet of life at **Confluence**. To top off our convention circuit, TFVC President Rebecca Hardy joined Del Bigtree, Dr. Peter McCullough, Dr. Seema Nanda, Dr. Sherri Tenpenny, and Dr. David Erb on stage at the **Freedom Summit** in Tarrant County last weekend. The TFVC table was the place to be, where our team had the opportunity to engage with and educate nearly 500 attendees on the **current state of the medical liberty movement in Texas.** Team TFVC has never been **more focused on our mission** , and we are deeply grateful for every opportunity to share our message of liberty with Texans across the state and the growing momentum for medical liberty. _**And a special thank you to our incredible volunteers... none of this work would be possible without YOU!**_

name: Grassroots Army
subject: STAND. What it cost…
body:
Time Sure Does Fly By
======================

My Family in 2020⬇
==================

STAND.
======

You all didn’t just hear about it... you watched it happen in real time. You saw what it cost when we chose to stand, and what our family went through because of it.
===================================================================================================================================================================

There was a season where standing was not just a decision... it was a daily weight. When we pushed back against unconstitutional lockdowns and mandates, it did not stay out there in the public square.... it came to our doorstep. It evolved into a run for governor, into exposing school boards, into moments that tested everything we believed in.


And with that came the hate, the attacks, the noise, the pressure that most people will never understand unless they have lived it.
===================================================================================================================================

But here is the truth... it either breaks you or it forges you. ⚒️🔥
=================================================================

Was it worth it? Absolutely. What I do it again? A thousand times over!
=======================================================================

Because through all of it, I did not just watch a movement grow... I watched my boys grow. I watched them see what it looks like when a man stands on conviction instead of comfort. I watched them learn that doing what is right is not always easy, not always popular, but always necessary.
==============================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================

Last week was my oldest son’s senior night. A moment that hits you harder than you expect. Now he is heading off to Michigan Tech to become a mechanical engineer. My youngest is stepping into his junior year, continuing to build himself in his own way. And I can say this with complete certainty... everything we went through made us stronger. Not just individually, but as a family.


Then life has a way of making you reflect.
==========================================

When Charlie Kirk was murdered, it forced me to ask a question most men avoid... what would I leave behind for my boys if something happened to me? Not money. Not things. But truth. Standards. Expectations. A blueprint. 📖
============================================================================================================================================================================================================================

That is where the Amazon best seller, “Men Are Forged, Not Found” came from.
============================================================================

It was never supposed to be a book. It was a manifesto. Something I was going to lock in a safe with a letter to my boys because God called me up to the big leagues a little sooner than expected. I wanted a guide for my sons on what it means to be a man and what it actually takes to become successful in a world that is constantly trying to weaken them.


And now it is out in the world... reaching men, shaping men, forging men. 💪🏽
==========================================================================

I am grateful beyond words to see it in your hands, to hear your stories, to know that something that started as a manifesto to my boys is now impacting families across the country.
=====================================================================================================================================================================================

This journey was never easy. But it was worth it. Every second of it.
=====================================================================

“Men Are Forged, Not Found” is available now on Amazon. If you have read it, leave a review so we can reach the next man who needs it.
======================================================================================================================================

Each one teach MANY!
====================

I appreciate you all!
======================

💪🏽🇺🇸
====

-Garrett
========

You can buy the book here 👇
===========================

**GJS Investments LLC**

8357 Barony Pt, 49071, Mattawan

| Peter,
The Supreme Court's decision gutting the Voting Rights Act didn't happen by accident. It was the product of a decades-long campaign by dark money groups, billionaires, and conservative operatives to pack the Court with extremist judges -- and last week, that investment paid off.
The case at the center of it was Louisiana v. Callais. The target was Congressional District 6 -- a majority-Black district born out of a compromise between Louisiana Republicans and Democrats. MAGA turned around and contested it anyway, challenging it all the way to the Supreme Court, where their installed justices ruled it was an "unconstitutional" racial gerrymander.
This was a setup. A coordinated plan to hand MAGA's Court a vehicle to gut the Voting Rights Act and restore the era of Jim Crow by dismantling Black representation and Democratic power in one ruling.
Here's how you know. The Court ruled a district can be too Black. They have never, not once, ruled a district can be too white. Consider what's been sitting on the map for decades without a single legal challenge:

* Kentucky's 5th District: 94% white. The single whitest congressional district in the entire nation. Never challenged.

* Alabama's 4th District: Explicitly drawn alongside a majority-Black district next door -- AL-07. AL-04, the white district created by the same racial sorting, has never been challenged. Not once.

* Mississippi's 1st District: Made whiter by deliberately packing Black voters into MS-02 next door. The same racial sorting Republicans now call unconstitutional -- when it benefits Black voters. When it benefits white ones? Not a word.

* Texas: People of color drove 95% of the state's population growth after 2020. Republicans responded by cracking Black and Latino communities across multiple districts -- splitting Austin, San Antonio, Houston, and Dallas apart to dilute minority votes and produce whiter, safer Republican seats. Never struck down.

* South Carolina's 1st District: Republicans packed Black voters into SC-06, leaving SC-01 overwhelmingly white. When challenged, they called it partisan, not racial. The white district that resulted from that sorting has never been touched.

* Georgia: Republicans cracked Black communities in the Atlanta suburbs across multiple districts to prevent a second majority-Black district. The white districts produced by that cracking? Never challenged.

These districts weren't accidentally white. They were made white by the same racial sorting that created majority-Black districts nearby. Only the Black districts got challenged. Only the Black districts got struck down.
That's not a legal standard. That's a double standard. And this Supreme Court, stacked with partisan puppets installed by dark money and MAGA operatives. just enshrined it into law. The mask is fully off.
[The Supreme Court is dragging us back to a pre-Civil Rights era. Hard-fought rights are being dismantled to benefit billionaire donors and MAGA. It's time to reform the Court and take it back from the partisan operatives who hijacked it. Our voting rights, our reproductive rights, our right to hold corporations accountable, all of it is on the line. If you agree, sign our petition right now:](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001zgnNe3JLYakRJLlFtbpckjgAW21trn2ueZ_8OCJJRZXTdLZZLAnR5uelV_hcPoRpj4k0XjJm3PfElQVxsZlAxmyUJD4Ojoj0SCkvMno3WLBo87dtlU0A9tPMEOUdVtH9UcUJebsYRvLVJ-8maQYlX8evzN_OesBdo7-XlICwJ6-YFl1udiNjvD7hx6JIGaosX9cAVRxVUwE6D2itfdHzvw==&c=1-IcLfngFlvsVnyWF8KdC5PS2bTsNGx5jiMOOo28scwV0jjLFhJ5Vw==&ch=D-AfLzBZweEerOJA9ApwthOQbRdxAmJ9gJ3BavndMyMa9DDpFX_nEw==)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | Elon Musk Just Declared War on the IRS. Joining Steve is Roger Simon Novelist and Screen writer best known for story credits A Better Life movie, author of numerous books including The Lost Coast, Directors Cut, including his latest book American Refugees a book that chronicles A net exodus of Americans from blue to red states that has been in progress for several years now. This is largely a southbound movement, and perhaps some migrants are "running from the cold up in New England," as the song goes. But mostly they are leaving states that are too far gone into woke socialism to recover anytime soon--in favor of states with more conservative governance.
Roger L. Simon is an Oscar-nominated screenwriter, award-winning novelist, and commentator. He was co-founder/CEO of PJ Media and editor-at-large of The Epoch Times. He has written numerous works of fiction and nonfiction exploring politics, culture, and moral conflict. EMET marks a return to the thriller form, blending contemporary upheaval with ancient questions of faith and truth.

| Peter,
Are you ready to jump in and make an impact in Massachusetts politics? Or know someone who is?
The Massachusetts Republican Party is gearing up for the 2026 cycle and looking for summer interns to join our team in Boston.
This is a chance to get out of the classroom and into real campaign work. You'll be part of the day-to-day, helping with strategy, events, communications, and stepping in where needed to keep things moving.
🔥 What You'll Do:
* Work alongside the HQ team on day-to-day party operations and campaign coordination
* Help craft messaging and social media content that reaches voters across the state
* Support event planning, outreach, and logistics
* Jump in wherever needed to keep the operation running strong

💥 What We're Looking For:
* A strong interest in politics, campaigns, or grassroots organizing
* Sharp communication skills and a team-first mindset
* Attention to detail and the ability to stay organized in a fast-moving environment
* Familiarity with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel); CRM/YAMM experience is a bonus
* A willingness to hustle, learn fast, and take initiative

⏱ Details:
* 10+ hours/week
* In-person in Boston
* Runs through August 2026, with opportunities to stay on through the election cycle

🚀 Why Join?
* Gain hands-on experience in real political operations
* Build connections with Republican leaders, candidates, and activists
* Develop skills that will set you apart in politics, business, or public service
* Play a role in driving Republican victories across Massachusetts

📩 Interested? Apply now!
Send your resume and availability to [info@massgop.com](mailto:info@massgop.com).
-Team MassGOP

**The U.S. Dollar Threat to Your Retirement**
_**National debt is $39 trillion. BRICS is dismantling the dollar. The Fed keeps printing money.**_
---
Here’s the number you need to know: $192.

That’s what it takes to buy what $100 did in 2000.

Almost _double._

That means a lot fewer groceries. A lot less travel. A lot less money to leave your kids.

And if you’ve been in the War Room, you know the losses just keep getting worse.

Every dollar the Fed prints is like a tax on your savings.

Your retirement doesn’t just have to grow. It has to _outrun_ the shrinking dollar.

And you know it won’t change soon.

Vladimir Putin put it bluntly at the 2025 BRICS summit:
---
**“In 2024 ... the ruble, along with the currencies of friendly nations, accounted for 90% of Russia’s settlements with other BRICS states.”**
---
That’s not the whole world abandoning the dollar.

But it's a warning. And a clear attack on American retirement savings.

Take a hard look at your own retirement accounts...

Can they carry you through 20 or 30 years of higher and higher costs? **If the answer is no, you must check out Augusta’s[2026 Wealth Preservation Guide](https://link.email.america1stwarroom. "2026 Wealth Preservation Guide") and see what thousands of Americans are doing to protect their savings. **

Here’s what most people don’t realize until the window closes:
---
**Your retirement accounts are paper-based assets tied to markets that can swing wildly and a dollar that buys less every single year.**
---
Last year, a record percentage of Americans dipped into retirement accounts just to cover emergencies. Many aren't even saving for retirement anymore — they're surviving on it.

**But you have time to fix it.**

What retirement needs to survive is an asset outside the paper system — one that broadly diversifies risk.

That asset is **physical gold.**

No counterparty risk. Answers to no central bank. Outlasted every financial crisis in history.

And the **data backs it up.**

In 2025, gold was up 64.5% in a single year. More than nearly every other asset.

In early 2026, gold surged past $5,000 an ounce — with a record high of almost $5,600.

And here’s what most Americans haven’t heard, because the financial industry profits from keeping your money right where it is...
---
**Federal tax law gives you the right to move your IRA, 401(k) or other tax-advantaged retirement account directly into physical gold — in a gold IRA — without triggering taxes or penalties.**
---
It’s IRS-approved. And available right now to help you protect your future from this dollar-shrinking insanity.

name: Judicial Watch Tipsheet
subject: Judicial Watch Victory: Arizona Appeals Court Rules State AG Kris Mayes’ Office Failed to Follow Law in Public Records Lawsuit
body:
Judicial Watch announced today that the Arizona Court of Appeals overturned a lower court’s decision that allowed Arizona State Attorney General Kris Mayes to hide documents about its anti-Trump legal actions with a controversial outside left-wing group. The decision cited failures by the Mayes’ office to both properly search for and justify the secrecy of records concerning its coordination with States United Democracy Center.

subject: An excellent way to honor a mom this Mother’s Day
body:
But not every woman will experience Mother’s Day that way.

| | | | [](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc2OnDAQhJ-muTEyNjbMgcNKiFOIlGykHFFjN4wV_yDbs5t5-4iIPECO3VWqT931c15mtM6G_St6GlLZlpQXDPRbk3MUyie-SnzEEBP66BfOuKqZrJk8fU1lBqMNNrqioem67t53vRLVY5C0qTvKjZhs-1a1PaEyhHTHjhkyrLLDGcUkk40QDeM3lM3a3zUS3-S6ooCWoaNUbomO5-qsxlAw_9pi0nTT0VdueJRyZBBvwCfg024_6HYkWmMKpwH4dE3AJx_Lg1KuDb5ATFmDGOfxjUmu3uf3L8AV-gJi5D1wtWcQIwbg6ln8kuMzaQIxHinmg3SxYb8kT8Y-PYiRPFp3LTX6A-0eQIwX9GReWgyFwgmam-VbV3__MdX_3lClwRyf1jmbVQct28_Mv4eW_6_lY-B_AgAA__-pt5xa)
---
Friend of Life, This Mother’s Day weekend, many people will call their moms, sit around a table together, or take a moment to remember the woman who gave them life. In those moments, it becomes clear just how much of who we are has been shaped by someone who chose to step into motherhood, even when it required sacrifice, patience, and strength. **But not every woman will experience Mother’s Day that way.** Right now, there are women sitting alone, trying to decide if they will become mothers at all. Everything around them is telling them to move quickly, to decide before they have time to process what’s happening, before they have space to ask questions, before they have ever seen the life they carry. Some of them are sitting in their cars, staring at the doors in front of them, telling themselves this is the only way forward, even though something inside them keeps asking them to wait just a little longer. **[And if nothing interrupts that moment, the decision will be made in minutes.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc2OnDAQhJ-muTEyNjbMgcNKiFOIlGykHFFjN4wV_yDbs5t5-4iIPECO3VWqT931c15mtM6G_St6GlLZlpQXDPRbk3MUyie-SnzEEBP66BfOuKqZrJk8fU1lBqMNNrqioem67t53vRLVY5C0qTvKjZhs-1a1PaEyhHTHjhkyrLLDGcUkk40QDeM3lM3a3zUS3-S6ooCWoaNUbomO5-qsxlAw_9pi0nTT0VdueJRyZBBvwCfg024_6HYkWmMKpwH4dE3AJx_Lg1KuDb5ATFmDGOfxjUmu3uf3L8AV-gJi5D1wtWcQIwbg6ln8kuMzaQIxHinmg3SxYb8kT8Y-PYiRPFp3LTX6A-0eQIwX9GReWgyFwgmam-VbV3__MdX_3lClwRyf1jmbVQct28_Mv4eW_6_lY-B_AgAA__-pt5xa)** That is why PreBorn! exists. Because when a woman is given the chance to see her baby on an ultrasound, something begins to change. The screen lights up. The heartbeat fills the room. What once felt distant suddenly becomes real in a way she cannot ignore. For the first time, she is no longer choosing in fear or pressure, but with clarity. And more than 80% of women choose life in that moment. Months later, she is not carrying the weight of a decision she cannot undo or wondering what might have been. She is holding her baby. **[This Mother’s Day, there is no more meaningful way to honor a mom in your life than by helping another woman become one.](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyUkc2OnDAQhJ-muTEyNjbMgcNKiFOIlGykHFFjN4wV_yDbs5t5-4iIPECO3VWqT931c15mtM6G_St6GlLZlpQXDPRbk3MUyie-SnzEEBP66BfOuKqZrJk8fU1lBqMNNrqioem67t53vRLVY5C0qTvKjZhs-1a1PaEyhHTHjhkyrLLDGcUkk40QDeM3lM3a3zUS3-S6ooCWoaNUbomO5-qsxlAw_9pi0nTT0VdueJRyZBBvwCfg024_6HYkWmMKpwH4dE3AJx_Lg1KuDb5ATFmDGOfxjUmu3uf3L8AV-gJi5D1wtWcQIwbg6ln8kuMzaQIxHinmg3SxYb8kT8Y-PYiRPFp3LTX6A-0eQIwX9GReWgyFwgmam-VbV3__MdX_3lClwRyf1jmbVQct28_Mv4eW_6_lY-B_AgAA__-pt5xa)** $28 provides one ultrasound, and that single moment can change everything. Will you step into that moment today?

| | | Friend — Last week, a federal court blocked access to mifepristone by mail, even for people in places where abortion is still legal. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsFlYb8tSgv_iNH9eUO8IibbLOfX6PT-3gGyMq8W09rTWGkhpOgx1v3_y0wksFDKhC57umKjg75i7zm7NBFpOE9lWw97IYC8yPYy0Kk-UeyQi8kYtPLtV6LYtIE7v0wNmAQstewwxV4vS1BlpBZR1AembuvVm88ej-Kty4NdLqKRBW2wxNZ2az2R0EQCcTY82SThK09HwpKG7VSVZz3kAwACQ4SpkK8s3cF2rUP3yG6bCy9e-tlGvEmI3pyp1EQSKHD5qKrmO0X5-3kovkL48eqhBaaSi-KxV0SJVZExq7cT-2rFPBimJ5nQM-kIaUtfPA/4qd/NellFYxKRSSXSTWxDQIDnA/h0/h001.FztUv8DvHeUDcLdWYQTG4hdJO6gUX26SZT4R6e9NPoE)And although SCOTUS might have put a temporary hold on this ruling, _MAGA is still suing to ban abortion by mail._ For many women, mail is not only the most accessible way to get care, it is their only access to reproductive care. And now it’s being taken away. **[This is what an all-out attack on reproductive rights looks like. Step by step, they’re trying to take your rights away. Please, donate now, and let’s fight back.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsFlYb8tSgv_iNH9eUO8IibbLOfX6PT-3gGyMq8W09rTfTVdCpsioUL_iS_P244ONuq183eCQUFgG-E12F1IDQNStPcWljzFEwPMYkF8KmhAuPSvx85DtrPIpOmSmamZcoEtP2Zlj3498tIUSkk-ZXd0SV2GZ2xTZfIR2MwLvLnB0B-93Saxv9YHDEDYzucS7B-zs-NKy7kasTHksaXzuGLhFDuynexVTniTPH3GZzO7hh4iwHPEuGW1qCgudoMe5imTn_bRVlWXTq30ITHUKwwwGjWBQDkYnhLlGUuDDoCFQcNxiGxAVXUIvqVhQvl2aI/4qd/NellFYxKRSSXSTWxDQIDnA/h1/h001.ru8xh2wxHAD10mltAaAQMupnknDLrNFB9Fz0yj5RG-o)** I’ve worked with families who already have to make impossible choices between paying rent, keeping their job, or taking care of their health. Friend of Life, This Mother's Day weekend, many people will call their moms, sit around a table together, or take a moment to remember the woman who gave them life. In those moments, it becomes clear just how much of who we are has been shaped by someone who chose to step into motherhood, even when it required sacrifice, patience, and strength. **But not every woman will experience Mother 's Day that way.** Right now, there are women sitting alone, trying to decide if they will become mothers at all. Everything around them is telling them to move quickly, to decide before they have time to process what's happening, before they have space to ask questions, before they have ever seen the life they carry. Some of them are sitting in their cars, staring at the doors in front of them, telling themselves this is the only way forward, even though something inside them keeps asking them to wait just a little longer. **[And if nothing interrupts that moment, the decision will be made in minutes.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/zrfwFQHql1FMmN65TO8y-WfDaCT0d9_SMSe-rleOQl_eKaIAgNRcSPVpYmg-0x5CuBMuwfKMvtz1atY6Py3AuWilm-1fciV7mmR7jdue_wyKdB8eCt8yQ9-t9CiFAbhOfThTsw5MMDB-S-hGyGgPNaZNcxteibYL9wOc8MahU7v8vtxS8L1r1F06wkYraq189l0P1cOWwmWEtuM34e6tAY7gPLnOUgAfwIb9owKZ0ggGPyQvnWS0uWqH6qBsNjw3mZaMKfeYRYX7g3DtUbW2ibr3IWZK74swpOgaGi4hKJkzEG8j-DVJnughoXYzkx_SP2vueN50d5SY1A_xppgl2V2D2PP34HFVCyCiqDuHiWZ65m7OmpoGMVUfa6bkvxeKrrefg_Bx2c0xEvh6GnEMoWa-FV7QGuSOk9mV7ZWwcZP01UdPwVo5K_nJB-0v6_oAlSgLih13GjuvL6vvh1Y2A5viLCowzUGWDTqP6dvM__mbeCl6XNkyrAp9MHDZmxzZnP8Z07diA3AjsuxyKoWmoTsRxfI0-KxoJjqwyQJiizbaNpIRLCVnKgfPrvrVnqSHBS-1hcrq1spD6vV_pV4xT0CE1_K_LBUEXz1ArloXJOtLvnsH7cT7A9-zTn36YFMd6bDPvtnZkKmhC-dSfbrDpJXJ_97LL_5KxCD5AxiZF-VSYdP2uA85F2mGQ3Nvk0PtPg/kUKBsffknMtflLNnowJ3DZcEHPaogWXg/20)** That is why PreBorn! exists. Because when a woman is given the chance to see her baby on an ultrasound, something begins to change. The screen lights up. The heartbeat fills the room. What once felt distant suddenly becomes real in a way she cannot ignore. For the first time, she is no longer choosing in fear or pressure, but with clarity. And more than 80% of women choose life in that moment. Months later, she is not carrying the weight of a decision she cannot undo or wondering what might have been. She is holding her baby. **[This Mother’s Day, there is no more meaningful way to honor a mom in your life than by helping another woman become one.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/LC84p6CJdy-N8Dl3MOIW2VG6oKlVv53ACNHvh38K5LxNs3jxrueuAoLZ8NGPssHLpu6IKeDQLTLZr2bz7KVFgeQfowTT3YYWwzVgxUVMDgpvo0vzbY7PfRVP0ByANcP8KKoKmomJKg1Q57ULS06EwowcwLdUK4zLOpkV91zW9WXfynl6vLxBgM9MZt72s1ptEf-zujIEJggPtn777hj-yfRE62QC_7o4R81F9ZUnNUmjzheKFNtiNYX3jJtuKDTAkok9gteZiA88pMM3vw9HetolGUrW1xQhGMoD7B_cnqd_LeK1nnTCsw7t6W5twq7KgJ6GcAvkCt5t1j7KkoSmxvIfl6QLeMgJuUzOEUxaq63DahTfiGasWUOmugZMCFoP5XWVIxopJulegFIEh4Kw0HxYTabWqdchuO25g78AfkitOW7fdcnI5Gr_wrlhDBWVHtYMvtEFI59XdiZ33moswKYSCuAoyakZpuShDoT7s5E5Cyx6TA5bkPXs06RGoohuqjre9Cvuo5KKLY3YEkSpNgRQB34qGDBLFgtZZ3AlMvz167vJNNBoutxUwWsk5VLpCoRLOL7ke5HtHQ4Cmxa6DF3HD3Zqh8UmNuGtJd2byv51lHsMUb9GQHzZCeuwR9pKYvmVqPafMkVcPPhV4_p8RkGh_RltCu2YygQo3_HqWmqJw7o91_HzM8PJ1t5ibRsULw/eV93cbYhTsNj4IMzUGbpsbiIOIu75dYN/20)** $28 provides one ultrasound, and that single moment can change everything. ---

| | It’s an age-old question: Can you have it all? What is “it,” anyway? Is it an Instagram-worthy marriage, children, friends, career... with a social life? Is it showing men that we have just as much upward mobility, focused on a career path as we also run a home, manage the kids’ schedules, and still have energy for more? Some of you are already spinning those plates, and once in a while, one crashes to the ground. You must stop everything, grab the broom and dustpan and then restart the feat of skill, agility, and mental calisthenics all over again. And that’s just a regular Monday. Most American moms already know there are things more important than careers — but that doesn't mean your degree or ambitions have to collect dust. Whether you're working nine-to-five, homeschooling, or juggling side gigs, here are 5 ways to boost your potential without going crazy! | | Friend,
Fourteen days. That's all that's left before Republicans in Kentucky decide who they want to carry their banner this November and replace the retiring Mitch McConnell in the U.S. Senate.
It's the most important fourteen days of this campaign. And I want to tell you exactly where I'm going to spend them.
Andy Barr decided he didn't _need_ to stand on a stage tonight and answer Kentuckians' questions about why he should be Kentucky's next U.S. Senator. He pulled out of a Senate debate that was scheduled for this evening. He didn't get sick. He didn't have a family emergency. He just decided he didn't have to.
**In a free country, that's not how this works.** Your vote isn't owed to anyone. It has to be earned – by showing up, by answering hard questions, and by looking voters in the eye.
So here's what I'm going to do instead.
**This week, I'm going on a tour.**
**We're calling it the Kentucky First Tour – and over the next 14 days, my team and I are making 30+ stops across the Commonwealth (**[**check out the schedule here**](https://eot.cameronforkentucky.com/f/a/c5sFN8MmOiUFPjeSpDcvUw~~/AAAHURA~/4m0GA2Hx3GghpuNfGq0ty8mEOOv6iOnTjF4W1QHtprgzG4z-e33vaXvET16HjQfqqX3jWGoutPhFOyBdTdrzacKOOtMNTzp2b6x5Ubfm78IfgwUnniOIWuz0jD8sjfMDDmoNWxOH0uZ3yYpTvNPjDLjYkZuQAf_zntZH2Ct8KvE~)**).** I'll be sharing my record, laying out my plans, _and listening_. Because the people who send me to the Senate should be the ones driving the agenda. Not Washington. Not the lobbyists.
That's the difference in this race.
As Kentucky's Attorney General, I sued the Biden Administration to protect our coal jobs, took on the cartels poisoning our communities, and stood up for religious liberty in court. In the Senate, that's the fight I'll bring every day – the border, our energy, life, and working families. Not Washington's. Not the lobbyists. Yours.
That's what "Kentucky First” means.
**Here's where I need your help:**

Every dollar fuels the car, funds more events, keeps our ads on the air, and turns out voters across Kentucky on May 19.
Andy Barr can hide if he wants to. I'm choosing the road – every step, every conversation, every Kentuckian I meet between now and Election Day.
I won't slow down. Not for him. Not for anyone.
– Daniel

The Wall Street Journal wrote a piece on our bill to remove taxpayer funding from Idaho teachers unions.

| |
---|---|---
|

| | | [Brian Lenney](https://substack.com/@brianlenney)

The Wall Street Journal [wrote a piece](https://substack.com/redirect/ad0db17e-44ce-42ab-b812-cb06c4adc1a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on our bill to remove taxpayer funding from Idaho teachers unions.
Good.
I hope more follow.
Because right now, your tax dollars pay the salary, union dues come out of that salary, then the union lobbies for things you'd never vote for.
_**You 're literally funding organized opposition to yourself **_
(This stops July 1st in Idaho)
We used to understand this instinctively. Government shouldn't bankroll groups that negotiate against the taxpayers writing the checks. Doesn't matter if it's teachers or anyone else carrying a union card.
Public sector unions aren't private ones.
Idaho got it right.
Every other state should be asking why they haven't done this yet.
Cheers,
Brian
**P.S.** There's a primary election coming up on May 19th in Idaho. Go vote. And bring a carful of friends with you. This is the most important election in Idaho because it's where you get to decide what kind of Republican goes on to represent you in the statehouse.

body:
A plan to transform state government to work for Minnesotans

|
---

| | Peter, if Minnesotans give me the opportunity to serve as governor, I will transform our state government into one that is innovative, effective, and accountable. **1\. Minnesota must start with innovation.**

In addition to expanding businesses and bringing in jobs, we need to replace our decades-old tech and IT systems with modern technology.

Right now, there are government offices in Minnesota still using computer systems with black screens and blinking cursors. I want to see modern technology that delivers results and holds government accountable.

We can create cutting-edge jobs in industries of the future while investing in our state’s number one asset: Our people.

**2\. Let’s make government effective by cutting through the muck.**

Getting a permit or a license shouldn’t feel like a part-time job. We can set deadlines for housing permit reviews and streamline building codes to make it easier to build more houses -- lowering costs for owners and renters alike.

We will use the full buying power of our state to negotiate lower prices for prescription drugs – I’ve long led on this issue in Washington, and we can use our power here to bring down prices. With costs as high as they are because of tariffs and the war in Iran, I know that every dollar saved matters.

**3\. Minnesotans have to see for themselves that their government can be trusted.**

On day one, I will begin a top-to-bottom audit of our state government. We must root out and stop the fraud, and insist on accountability for those who stole taxpayer dollars. We will strengthen criminal penalties and extend the statute of limitations for fraud across state programs.

We must create a “Do Not Pay” database to automatically block anyone with a proven fraud history from getting state grants and contracts, and establish a permanent ban on anybody convicted of fraud. And to those convicted of fraud who rebrand under a new name or try to sneak in the side door: That door will be locked. **Minnesotans are right to have high expectations.** They have deadlines they meet every day. They plan and prioritize for their families. They see something that isn’t working, and they fix it. Our government should do the same.

**I want to build that future together. But to accomplish everything we’re setting out to do, I’m going to need your support.**

Last week, the Supreme Court made the decision to gut the Voting Rights Act (VRA) – a landmark civil rights measure that enshrines equal opportunities for underrepresented groups to ensure they have a voice in our democracy.
To say that I am absolutely appalled by this decision is an understatement.

body:
Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
After the House passed the SAVE America Act recently (the latest version of the anti-voting SAVE Act), the Senate is all we have left to stop this suppressive legislation from becoming law ahead of the midterm elections, folks.

Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet on the impact of these bills:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, join these brave Senators today. Fuel our efforts to stop this dangerous legislation with $25 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=050526_1&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=050526_1&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=050526_1&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=050526_1&amount=50]
GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=050526_1&amount=100] GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=050526_1&amount=250] OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=050526_1&amount=35]
We know the SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before the next election, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
If you missed it: This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=050526_1&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=050526_1&amount=20]

name: Tim Walz
subject: From one teacher to another
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Small Town PAC, [smalltownpac
body:
Let’s send more teachers to serve our communities in the halls of power.
#
Hi Peter,
Happy National Teacher Day to all the teachers out there!
Long before I even considered getting into politics, I spent most of my life as a teacher. Before I was Governor Walz or Congressman Walz, I was Mr. Walz and Coach Walz.
I started by volunteering to teach English and American History to high school students overseas. My first teaching gig here in the States was in Alliance, Nebraska, a town of 10,000 people. That’s where I ended up meeting my wife and fellow teacher, Gwen.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260505-1.SFhUEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-590&t=1&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)
After we got married and moved to Mankato, I taught geography and coached football at Mankato West High School, where I worked for a decade before taking a leave of absence to run for Congress.
I made some of my fondest memories there, always seeking to be a mentor to my students beyond the classroom. Two of my proudest moments were helping lead our football team to win a state championship after years of losing every game, and being named “Most Inspiring Teacher.”
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260505-1.SFhUEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-590&t=2&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)
My goal was to always improve students’ lives and help them see the potential in themselves. Now, with Small Town PAC, I want to do the same thing by helping teachers see that they can run for office and expand their impact far outside of the classroom.
I didn’t know the first thing about running a political campaign, but Wellstone Action gave me the time of day, the training, and the resources to figure it out and win. That’s what we’re aiming to do for teachers in small towns all over the country.
**I know that the more teachers we elect to local, state, and federal office, the more students and families we can help, and the stronger we can make our public schools.**
But I need your help to do it, Peter. Small Town PAC is just getting started, and we’re depending on grassroots donations from folks like you to get on the road and start recruiting more teachers to run.
[**Can you pitch in $5 or more this National Teacher Day to help us send more caring, hardworking teachers to serve our communities in the halls of power?**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260505-1.SFhUEX&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-590&t=3&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260505-1.SFhUEX&amount=5&refcode=20260505-590&t=22&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)**
With gratitude,
Tim

Tim Walz started Small Town PAC to build a Democratic Party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
Together, we're finding and recruiting thoughtful, hardworking people to run for office, and supporting a new generation of leaders who truly reflect and understand their communities.
**[It’s time for Democrats to expand the map and put small towns back at the forefront: pitch in now to help build our movement from the ground up.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260505-590&t=23&refcode2=590_34582_Nolr6D&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)**
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stp-ms-em-footer?refcode=em20260505-590-&t=24&refcode2=590_34582_Nolr6D&akid=590%2E34582%2ENolr6D)**

I grew up in a working-class family as the granddaughter of a police officer and the daughter of two teachers. As a child, I had an interest in engineering, which led me to receive a college scholarship to study electrical engineering.
After working at General Motors, I transitioned to running a small business with my husband. Together, we operated four restaurants in our community and provided new opportunities and mentorship to our employees.
Then, I went on to serve my community in the Oregon State Legislature. I was proud to fight for Oregonians and ensure their voices were heard, but I knew I had to do more if I was going to build a better future for the next generation.
With encouragement from my mom, I decided to run for Congress. Now, I’m honored to be serving my first term in the House as Oregon’s first Black U.S. Representative.
I’ve fought hard to deliver for Oregonians. I introduced bills to protect food assistance and rural healthcare. I passed legislation in the House to support wildfire victims. I demanded the Republican-led House bring a cost-fighting bill to the floor. And I introduced bold ideas to help young Americans get ahead.
_And we’re not done yet._
**But look, National Republicans are determined to flip this seat back to red. House Republicans just announced they’re going to spend millions of dollars bombarding the airwaves in Portland — and they could use those ads to attack me.**

After working at General Motors, I transitioned to running a small business with my husband. Together, we operated four restaurants in our community and provided new opportunities and mentorship to our employees. Then, I went on to serve my community in the Oregon State Legislature. Dear Patriot, They're trying to put an innocent cop in prison for **life**. Why? For defending himself against a fleeing suspect who dragged him with a car. I've been in law enforcement for decades. I've seen the system abused. But what is happening to Officer James Brennand of San Antonio, Texas makes my blood boil, and it should make yours boil too. On October 2nd, 2022, Officer James Brennand — a decorated Army veteran who swore an oath to protect his community — spotted a car he suspected was stolen outside a McDonald's in San Antonio. He called for backup. He approached the vehicle. He ordered the driver to step out. The driver's response? He threw the car into reverse and used it as a weapon. | [Defend Officer Brennand →](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5d7acdb4f47848a5bd8a9fe19c25c080&_e=803De9Hj0mmkuDvidXYXJjCXqfEKm17nRJ55SJkecE14tW2kd2VCtq4xAy9Celft0unOQSBosCXju-KSybD21TIw_-vn7sJkiXa_jv_oeqSekyj1Vaxzpc5azVlGMjCvUsHnOYlIuQSBRrWoFsHHSUY9LQpANkCPpDil0-1NB5dCv-gzRo0LfAAvCVP-KfZwvOBfhZqSUXWjvt-gEzBRsbDqVADWbThc1Umtazyh2z7XSyPDzwp5bCtyI5vtoz2MZrl1csbxUj6EHoKdRahfJi67c5xwGsiyxffB47DNvLuMsHajBLbFjJGTItVRhQDPOJmtfZA-Ubu9P6nDh3fbLDZBSCHpvkli8Da4z8V1Rhc1mQwsWQMr06KhUv-eGN3PEUTXCMtj2pB91txcNDaUWfLVOh8A-aYGjVnVQyNMyp3AWTCYakQpoh5jFjmKWx-E)
---
The car door slammed into Brennand. He was dragged. In that split second — outnumbered, without backup, in genuine danger — James did what every officer is trained to do. **He protected himself.**
The driver survived. The passenger was unharmed. And since that night, the driver has racked up four more arrests. **Four.**
While the man who attacked James faces no meaningful consequences, Officer Brennand has been stripped of his badge, his paycheck, and his future. A politically hungry District Attorney — more interested in headlines than justice — charged James with aggravated assault and deadly conduct. If convicted: **five years to life.**
Let that sink in. A man who served his country in the Army, who volunteered to protect the streets of San Antonio, who was dragged by a car in the line of duty — could die in prison.
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5d7acdb4f47848a5bd8a9fe19c25c080&_e=803De9Hj0mmkuDvidXYXJjCXqfEKm17nRJ55SJkecE14tW2kd2VCtq4xAy9Celft0unOQSBosCXju-KSybD21TIw_-vn7sJkiXa_jv_oeqSkSLp7PD5yo3P1_8gogfCKS45MQglXgNEErkIxRXjakQdmLXMQKJuVgtpX_w9EES0Ebv49fj8BBlEuzj1s6Gdgt7ZgWxgN4h-ORdFiifEvBIBFeLPl5_zINj96Ks2U_NGH69hpXQX39rIpSvGCt2nSzlZ-1hFu057QVCj6R6sqHefMNFvTxhOPYPCv23fkZM8iiel14ubSm9Q5HQX6U7H_Z7WOO1DjtBjbrQ96LaUUrQRbpG87v7Q3TagDPtIKcaaqhGeQwb8jMnJTtk3mv4W90zYRQyOn2a2P3zcJPt7zSXKpY6BTLY8Gdg95bO9uGqpdUuEhffPXD3mNoDTv6sA1) James and his son — a family now fighting for survival while awaiting trial.
The National Center for Police Defense is in this fight with James — funding his legal defense and supporting his family while this nightmare drags on toward trial. But the costs are staggering, and they don't stop. **[That's why I need you, right now, today, to make a donation. $25. $50. $100.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=5d7acdb4f47848a5bd8a9fe19c25c080&_e=803De9Hj0mmkuDvidXYXJjCXqfEKm17nRJ55SJkecE14tW2kd2VCtq4xAy9Celft0unOQSBosCXju-KSybD21TIw_-vn7sJkiXa_jv_oeqQUMNlCcweXi9oMSXNJIA4YjfoXR8eiaCluTR8smj95WS-HayvU2ZZdy2TruhI5TN6m6bjY9CBNG9C0eNxMr041d5JlALr9H7_2BrZeA9K6NFHhWtf_PfL00IbKvsdNrZTueeO6N5wZ2TJlLW0IStQvw6dDLH8UMXZ9iawtvutifhegEWp0vs6cIGwjJ2K6EHYMcOp3hv1FCUR3lvJrybLVGxGhuF-9HLe1FJWXVD6EDzOvCLQtoOsYdHgHBRphl7_8ZPzDsoP0URpmu3TBFV7tdh7fCzwX1C2Mha8pLVWET6LbT9A_mnOgVe7Q5A4qMmjwLJiReXVQaMODYc2wvace) ** Whatever you can give. Your gift goes to defending James and keeping his family afloat. The anti-police mob is betting that people like you will scroll past, shake your head, and do nothing. **Prove them wrong.** James Brennand served this country with honor. He served his city with courage. When that car came at him, he stood his ground. Now it's our turn to stand with him. Don't let them take this good man down without a fight. Share this with every patriot and badge supporter you know. The thin blue line holds only as long as good people refuse to look away. **For James. For his son. clean_body: | Dear Patriot, They're trying to put an innocent cop in prison for life. Why? For defending himself against a fleeing suspect who dragged him with a car. I've been in law enforcement for decades. I've seen the system abused. But what is happening to Officer James Brennand of San Antonio, Texas makes my blood boil, and it should make yours boil too. On October 2nd, 2022, Officer James Brennand — a decorated Army veteran who swore an oath to protect his community — spotted a car he suspected was stolen outside a McDonald's in San Antonio. He called for backup. He approached the vehicle. He ordered the driver to step out. The driver's response? He threw the car into reverse and used it as a weapon. | The car door slammed into Brennand. He was dragged. In that split second — outnumbered, without backup, in genuine danger — James did what every officer is trained to do. He protected himself. The driver survived. The passenger was unharmed. And since that night, the driver has racked up four more arrests. Four. While the man who attacked James faces no meaningful consequences, Officer Brennand has been stripped of his badge, his paycheck, and his future. A politically hungry District Attorney — more interested in headlines than justice — charged James with aggravated assault and deadly conduct. If convicted: five years to life. Let that sink in. A man who served his country in the Army, who volunteered to protect the streets of San Antonio, who was dragged by a car in the line of duty — could die in prison. James and his son — a family now fighting for survival while awaiting trial. The National Center for Police Defense is in this fight with James — funding his legal defense and supporting his family while this nightmare drags on toward trial. But the costs are staggering, and they don't stop. Whatever you can give. Your gift goes to defending James and keeping his family afloat. The anti-police mob is betting that people like you will scroll past, shake your head, and do nothing. Prove them wrong. James Brennand served this country with honor. He served his city with courage. When that car came at him, he stood his ground. Now it's our turn to stand with him. Don't let them take this good man down without a fight. Share this with every patriot and badge supporter you know. The thin blue line holds only as long as good people refuse to look away. For James. For his son. For every officer who might be next. Unapologetically, Sheriff Joe Arpaio Former Sheriff, Maricopa County | Stand With Officer Brennand Today Your donation goes to his legal defense and his family. | | | | ---|---|---|--- National Center for Police Defense 10521 Judicial Drive, Suite 200 Fairfax, Virginia 22030

## Restoring law and order under Trump 2.0...
Most presidents hope to have one or two defining wins in their term.
One policy area that improved, one high profile diplomatic win, something to put next to their name in the history books.
But Trump hasn't been content with just one big accomplishment.
I've been talking in my last few columns about some of those win; each impressive on their own, but together?
It's a historic term, some might even say book-worthy.
Today I want to talk about another win in Trump 2.0: the return of law and order to the U.S.
In his 2016 speech accepting the Republican nomination, Donald J. Trump made a straightforward promise to the American people: "When I take the oath of office next year, I will restore law and order to our country."
He's keeping that promise.
Let's break down how...

name: James Carville
subject: I’m losing sleep over New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire is the map.
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $5 or whatever you can to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260505_1.l3bWwX&refcode=em20260505-1&t=1&akid=6482%2E582294%2EOIXEsV)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260505_1.l3bWwX&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-1&t=20&akid=6482%2E582294%2EOIXEsV)**
Chris is up just one point. One. 45-44. **That is a tied race.** And while the whole country is staring at Georgia and North Carolina, New Hampshire is sitting there in a dead heat with nobody riding to the rescue.
John Sununu — _yeah, those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**
Chris Pappas is the only guy who can win this seat. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to bring people together. But he cannot — _cannot_ — do this alone when every check is being written and every eyeball is looking somewhere else.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution to Chris Pappas today. $10, $25, $5, whatever you can spare. Because if we let this seat slip away while everybody’s watching Georgia, we’re gonna wake up in November and wonder how the hell we let it happen.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260505_1.l3bWwX&refcode=em20260505-1&t=21&akid=6482%2E582294%2EOIXEsV)**
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire _is_ the map. You hold this seat, and Democrats have a real path to the majority. You lose it, and it doesn’t matter what happens in North Carolina, Texas, Maine, or anywhere else.
Don’t let New Hampshire be the reason we come up one seat short.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260505_1.l3bWwX&refcode=em20260505-1&t=22&akid=6482%2E582294%2EOIXEsV)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

clean_body: | Friend, Last summer, President Trump and Republicans gutted health care and SNAP in their Big Ugly Bill – all while handing out new tax breaks for private jets to their wealthy friends. That’s not right – and it’s exactly why I just introduced a bill to fix it. My bill would block companies from writing off the cost of their private jets and other related expenses – because if you can afford a private jet, you can definitely afford to pay your fair share of taxes. Here in mid-Michigan, families are doing everything right and still getting squeezed. They shouldn’t have to compete with a tax code that rewards the ultra-wealthy for luxury perks. Working families pay their share. Billionaires should too. I came to Congress to level the playing field for working families. And that means taking on a system that’s been tilted toward the wealthy for far too long. | Thank you, Kristen = | We'd hate to see you go, but you can click here if you'd like to . **JULIA LETLOW WINS U.S. SENATE DEBATE, DRAWS SHARP CONTRAST WITH FLEMING** _Trump-endorsed conservative holds Fleming accountable on lobbying record, wealth accumulation, and abandoned duties_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** — Congresswoman Julia Letlow won today’s nearly two-hour U.S. Senate debate on the Moon Griffon Show, putting John Fleming on defense for his record while laying out a clear conservative vision for Louisiana.
Letlow drew direct contrasts with Fleming throughout the debate. She pressed him on his vote against the Farm Bill in 2014, his pro-CCS and illegal immigration votes he took while in Congress, his work as a federal lobbyist after leaving Congress, and his decision to abandon his duties as State Treasurer to pursue yet another office.
While holding Fleming accountable for his record, Letlow stayed focused on what Louisiana families are asking for. In Congress, she authored and passed the Parents Bill of Rights, giving parents real say in what their children are taught. She secured legislation included in the farm bill to protect Louisiana's agricultural producers. As a member of the House Appropriations Committee, she has worked to cut wasteful federal spending while delivering more than $200 million in targeted funding directly to Louisiana communities.
That record, combined with her commitment to strengthening Louisiana's oil and gas industry, securing the border, and standing with President Trump to advance the America First agenda, is what separates Letlow from a career politician who made Washington work for himself.
_"Louisiana voters deserve a senator who has spent every single day fighting for this state, not one who spent it fighting for themselves and their power in Washington,"_ **said Rep. Letlow.** _"Today made that choice crystal clear."_
Letlow also drew the broader contrast at stake in the May 16 primary. President Trump has given his complete and total endorsement to Letlow, while her opponents have abandoned Louisiana Republicans and publicly bashed the President.
_"Louisiana needs a senator who will pick up the phone, call the President, and get things done for our state,"_ **Rep. Letlow said.** _"That is what I will do every single day. I will never waver."_
Letlow will continue traveling Louisiana in the final days before the May 16 primary, meeting with voters across the state who are ready for conservative leadership that will not waver.
To learn more or get involved, visit [JuliaLetlow.com](https://us.list-manage.com/Iw9L8yc_sWo?e=95355a072c&c2id=cd64ea42b1b0eeac0fd7d107db75288a).

subject: SCOTUS just came for St. Louis voters.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BELL FOR MISSOURI
body:
I refuse to sit idly by and watch voters in our district be blatantly silenced. Peter,

Just last week, the Supreme Court issued a ruling that weakens parts of _The Voting Rights Act, _**and it could have real consequences here in St. Louis.**

The SCOTUS decision opens a window for state lawmakers to redraw congressional maps — _and there's a real risk Missouri Republicans will try to gerrymander MO-01 as early as this year._

This didn't happen overnight. Republicans have been chipping away at _The Voting Rights Act_ for decades. This latest ruling further weakens the guardrails that were supposed to protect communities of color from being divided up for political gain. The rules are even looser now, and Missouri Republicans have more room to move quickly when it comes to redistricting.

A lot of the recent map fights in Missouri have been playing out in Kansas City and the courts. But now the pressure is shifting, and St. Louis is directly in the spotlight. **When maps get redrawn like this, it's not just lines on paper. It changes whose voices get heard, and it changes who has power.**

The people of St. Louis — _especially Black voters_ — have spent decades building representation in this district. That work is now at risk of being undone.

Even if nothing changes before this election, the door is now open for future attempts to reshape the district in a way that weakens voter power. That's why I'm not waiting to see what happens next. We're organizing, fighting back, and making sure people understand what's at stake.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0b20c6b0e2ae/im-running-for-alabamas-most-flippable-state-senate-seat-in-15-years-13693770?e=62156fa6a8)

| | | | | |
# Our Voting Rights Are Under Attack in Alabama!
---
|
---
| | The Supreme Court just weakened the 1965 Voting Rights Act—and we’re already seeing the consequences.
We may not know the full impact yet, but the direction is clear. This decision opens the door for far-right politicians to rig the rules, push Democrats out of office, and silence Black voices in both state and federal government.
Here in Alabama, that could mean changes to the State Senate map—specifically District 26. If you’re interested in the details, you can read my full explanation [here](https://us.list-manage.com/PPKfs7f4dUT?e=62156fa6a8&c2id=b6a5a472a55a2c2f8f90113ea210fcd0).
So yes—there’s uncertainty. I may be talking to voters today who won’t be in this district by November. That’s frustrating. But it doesn’t change why we’re here. We don’t get to sit this out. We don’t get to give up.
If we want a democracy that works for all of us, we have to fight for it—every day, in every community, no matter what the maps look like.
While the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals considers the future of these districts, our work continues. This campaign has always been about more than lines on a map—it’s about building a better Alabama.
And no matter what happens, that’s exactly what I intend to do.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: The case of the missing $63 million
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We don't need Shaggy, Scooby, and the whole gang to figure this mystery out.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2884%2E4032634%2EOVJysQ)
---
What do ABC, Paramount, X, and Meta all have in common? Every single one of those companies settled lawsuits with Donald Trump — and promised to donate millions of dollars to his presidential library fund. We're talking up to $63 million total. Now here's where it gets interesting: That library fund? It disappeared, presumably with all those cash donations. Gone. Poof. Now, normally, the number one rule to solving a suspected crime is to follow the money. But this money has disappeared — and the giant corporations who handed it over don't seem particularly interested in clarifying where it went. I wonder why that is. Here's what we know: ABC settled first, agreeing to pay $15 million as a so-called "charitable contribution" to Trump's future presidential library. Meta, X, and Paramount followed. A fund was created to receive the money. Then, in September 2025, the state of Florida dissolved that fund after it failed to file a mandatory annual report. By December, it was formally shut down — with zero disclosure about where any of the money went. The trail goes cold right there. So why won't anyone answer the obvious question: where did the money go? Did it go right into the pocket of Donald Trump instead? We don't need Shaggy, Scooby, and the whole gang to figure this mystery out. But we do need you — because the more people demand answers, the harder it is for them to stay quiet. [**The American people deserve to know where this $63 million went. And I'm going to keep fighting until we find out. Are you with me? Add your name if you agree that Donald Trump and these companies must disclose where this money went.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-63mil/?source=EW_EMZ30Z_LIB_ENG_20260505_F&t=8&akid=2884%2E4032634%2EOVJysQ) | [**SIGN YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-63mil/?source=EW_EMZ30Z_LIB_ENG_20260505_F&t=9&akid=2884%2E4032634%2EOVJysQ)
---
And here's another thing that should make your blood boil: these companies may have written off their payments as charitable tax deductions.
So not only did they hand Trump millions to make their legal problems go away — American taxpayers may have subsidized it.
These CEOs didn't fork over millions because they suddenly decided to preserve presidential history.
They presumably paid because they wanted something from Donald Trump. And now they're staying quiet because they're still hoping to get it.
That's not how this works. Not on my watch.
I've already pressed each of these CEOs directly — along with my colleagues Senator Richard Blumenthal and Representative Melanie Stansbury — demanding a full accounting of where this money went. They had until March 23rd to respond.
I haven't gotten a straight answer yet. But I’m not letting up. I want them to know — and I want Donald Trump to know — that I am not dropping this.
[**Add your name if you agree the American people need answers about the missing $63 million.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-63mil/?source=EW_EMZ30Z_LIB_ENG_20260505_F&t=10&akid=2884%2E4032634%2EOVJysQ)
Thanks for being part of this,
Elizabeth

| | | Hi Peter, I want to tell you what protecting your right to vote looks like behind the scenes, because **I'm fighting (and winning!) these battles every day already.**
* **When election deniers tried to use a loophole to remove 23,000 voters from the rolls in my county, I stopped them.** I worked to develop a legal argument that made it possible for every county in the state to block these types of voter suppression attempts. And because of that work, your voter registration wasn’t cancelled.

Will you [help me do this for all of Colorado?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu9tkS213ThEvbRM6r3opeYk7aczehR1M71sLF0I3ijQ9qD8M_FunmFMC-9nFv97jTobQY8fWqwnjpuyOyl_KegK-VweyKqLCwvKe0Mgzp8uQcIkaQ6c2Oo_kItC-xarbc7_y1oXowEuDerMsSx86yCirdOBd2Vu2mRLdETGWDogaqLnj1h1Z4pgYc8grHfHYedun4WfWh0i8FCMk2F-WC3ifAu_m3rNFJdcUtt_xTMcG33VGOEBn-d2YZiQQl0QrCVbNG1NdtEuQBbEQIm9pLQyWsQzA2qV5cotRmUhwZnfg/4qd/LcKeMwaiRdugAJaURhjvDw/h0/h001.26CxXFndMP6zhe2l7Q2FcQIXQ-WtkIAUQkZnZOVYbh4)

Developing public policy and getting legislation over the finish line matters. I have that experience and expertise. But **that's also just one line on my resume.** I run elections for nearly half a million Coloradans. I’m the chief executive of a $20 million organization with over 100 staff. I’m a licensed attorney who has taught election law at DU, earned national awards for leadership in elections, and I hold a certificate in election administration from Auburn University. **There isn’t another candidate running who is as qualified and experienced in every aspect of the Secretary of State role as I am.** I've been in this fight for years. # **Support The Capitalist**
**[Become a paid subscriber today and access the Live Capitalist chat](https://substack.com/redirect/33ccff1f-7265-4e6d-9821-4db4282b198b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Subscribe here now](https://substack.com/redirect/33ccff1f-7265-4e6d-9821-4db4282b198b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
Coinbase **[just fired 700 people](https://substack.com/redirect/fe87bb37-7af3-4be2-8e04-c0d168239e71?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because AI does their jobs better. CEO Brian Armstrong can try and sugarcoat it but the facts are brutally stark, **[Coinbase is cutting 14% of its workforce](https://substack.com/redirect/4f54fd6d-e73d-4db0-a178-09e9823a9e0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** because artificial intelligence will do their jobs more effectively than the humans who currently hold them can.
This isn't some dusty legacy company being dragged painfully, kicking and screaming, into the 21st century. This is Coinbase, one of the most prominent, forward-leaning crypto firms on the planet, a company that has been at the forefront of the digital asset revolution, and even they are shedding human jobs because the machines are a better bet.
This is the face of AI adoption.
It arrives in the form of an internal email (**[you can read it here](https://substack.com/redirect/b1dca4b4-7f6f-4436-aca8-0eb4340fe2e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**) telling hard-working people that their roles are no longer needed because AI can do the work faster, cheaper, and with fewer errors. The people who lost their jobs weren't lazy, or stupid, they simply cannot compete with the machine. Their roles have been out evolved by a microchip and a prompt.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/b1dca4b4-7f6f-4436-aca8-0eb4340fe2e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To his credit, Armstrong was direct about it. The company is not just trimming fat for the sake of cost savings (of course there will be savings, but more on that later). It is fundamentally rethinking how it operates in an AI-native world. Layers are being flattened. Pure managers are being eliminated. Teams are being rebuilt around humans who can direct fleets of AI agents rather than doing the work themselves.
