Today we are just two weeks out from Alabama's Primary elections on May 19th.
As I've crisscrossed my home state over the past year, one thing has consistently struck me again and again as I've had the honor of meeting so many of my fellow citizens: We ALL share those unique traits that make us Alabamians:
* We work until the job is done or it's too dark to see.
* We say what we're going to do, and then do what we say.
* We expect everyone to work hard and pull their weight, but when they need help we don't hesitate to lend a hand to lift up our fellow human beings in times of need.

**And we are, every last one of us, sick and tired of politicians who represent NOTHING of who and what we really are.** We are fed up with "representatives" who talk at us rather than listening to us. They enjoy top tier healthcare and fat salaries while the rest of us fall further and further behind as we sweat a doctor's visit, a utility bill, a mortgage payment or just buying groceries or putting a tank of gas in the car.
In just a few short weeks, on May 19th, we have the opportunity to take the first step in putting an actual Alabamian in the U.S. Senate, someone who doesn't consider "affordability", "the rule of law" and the Constitution inconveniences while they gleefully ignore accountability time after time.
_[Your generous support has gotten us this far where we are leading our primary opponents in fundraising, endorsements, public engagement and earned media, but I need your help once again in these closing days of the Primary.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1c3cd31e-cd14-48df-8e5d-02edb33c823e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
**$25 will help us keep the truck on the road. $50 will help keep us supplied with walk cards. $100 will get more yard signs printed. Whatever you can afford to send, please know we will put it to work to win this election and to make sure we have an elected government that reflects our values instead of a government that dictates to us. Please go to[www.KyleforAlabama.com](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4f8a9c40-41dc-4695-94cc-5d7fd906fec3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** **to make a donation today!**
[ Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1c3cd31e-cd14-48df-8e5d-02edb33c823e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you again for the trust and support you have given our campaign to this point and thank you in advance for fighting for our democracy and for the values that unite us instead of dividing us.
With deepest appreciation,
Kyle Sweetser

We’d understand if you thought Pete Hegseth’s lawfare against Mark Kelly was over and done with.
#

Team, we’d understand if you thought Pete Hegseth’s attacks on Mark Kelly were over and done with.
Most people have moved on — understandably. A federal judge blocked Hegseth’s attempt to demote Mark and reduce his military pension back in February. It should’ve ended there, but it didn’t.
Hegseth appealed that ruling and Donald Trump refuses to let this go. The hearing for that appeal is this Thursday — two days from now. So, Mark’s case is going before a federal court, again. The First Amendment rights of every military retiree are on the line, as well as what Mark has earned over twenty five years in the Navy and NASA.
Hegseth and Donald Trump are using the full weight of the Executive Branch to go after Mark. That means everybody who cares about Mark needs to have his back, one more time.

## ****
Dear Fellow American, Since the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women 's Health Organization_ decision, the states have been empowered in ways they haven't for half a century to take real action to protect life. But groups like Planned Parenthood haven't gone away.

They are as determined as ever to push abortion--in what the _New York Times_ called "filthy facilities" and even through the mail and push dangerous gender transition drugs on minors.

And they want YOUR tax dollars to fund it. To fund an activist organization with a track record of putting radical abortion and gender-identity politics over people.

But you aren't helpless. You can partner with ADF's Center for Public Policy to make a difference--to help save babies and give mothers real opportunity to choose life, in state after state. That's not just hyperbole.

We're working to put an end to Planned Parenthood's gravy train of taxpayer funding and protect pro-life pregnancy centers--and we're succeeding.

## **Step 1: Defund Big Abortion**
One important way that pro-life state legislators and governors can make a real difference is to turn off the spigot of money that Big Abortion groups like Planned Parenthood receive.

Remember--money is fungible. That's YOUR money being spent to end unborn lives.

Thanks to the Supreme Court's ruling in Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic last year, states are free to defund abortion businesses like Planned Parenthood.

Here's one reason why this should be a no-brainer: _Planned Parenthood isn 't scraping by--it's flush with cash_. From 2018 to 2023 alone, it pulled in $3.2 billion in direct public funding, on top of hundreds of millions it receives every year from private donations. Since 2022, it's been riding a fundraising surge, stacking up more than $2.5 billion in net assets.

And don't buy the "non-abortion services" argument: that money they receive from the government doesn't go towards abortion. Money is fungible. **Every tax dollar you hand over frees up more resources for pro-abortion politicking and performing more abortions.**

Enough is enough.

Planned Parenthood should not get another cent from the paychecks of hardworking Americans, including you.

[**When you make your first gift today**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=0ed1838abe18463badd062174c42536a&_e=3bI5E9mBoEjOBYUCkjBvySsElaJMLdwUqGXr-0S1QN0B1okmnl8u9YtA40V4AKfKPkznAT3pIYuG7nzv3zwlg_7vLBVzCEix35cv-lsBEaT8s2NRHJpk_kwnIAQJLhz_SQ9bJWm_UgENZEqbSAt7Bs-JACLJ3Mqeh3jPvJJ8r-b-RsRLjWyZqRo1TEDU0mdYGdwyJ4PwNptmHG2R51ExP_lGni-2hPQYfva8Fg3Qf1PKineCOpxPYgADI4SQJbXS7ufCqmB9h8MZ78ncABn5bDwvdPSVzhRAuWo9inBziB-GtJQbVw2JKuLMP7TFN0VhnsD3GlifiuT6jOowLJNaAw2aMxKNUX6UNfOaUTQC2J_ifGa9xKFclDIrZbef8PU7qbpCjm4j-Iyo_8TT_grbQ_mvD61N1Z6JgvfsHGw-2F0g7LaByMYdcsngxfOcDv7xoCjQOtXoUykVP8uO3JJHnpeRQqB9eTKeyJSmRSr_uvbD_FFF03Vd7QUpuemprqeN_AP2eKq7t1AOxG0v8C3ih0DFvERlen-HcaT7kAHOZGdLupsxbIFy32BpELk5fA4auJfUNa_7GuuKQkPVjNNOaGP29h0gbdzWTOZ1VSbPFTnzacmd7j1NKU5Ba0b2wWeOXGUVLUQTzMLO-xqsgf9a7CBUtnaQW1JbtBwyeQ3qmvdYrDrIFzJ3FtZ2iVHH3noA),**you 'll be joining a team that is serious about stopping abortion and providing mothers with the support they need. States like Texas, South Carolina, Idaho, and Tennessee have already taken action to defund Planned Parenthood and other abortion businesses. We'll continue to ramp up our on-the-ground efforts to encourage other states to follow their lead.

## **Step 2: Protect Pregnancy Centers**
It's not enough to defund Big Abortion. We're committed to protecting pro-life pregnancy centers from government harassment and threats to their ability to serve their communities. They shouldn't be forced to endure time-consuming litigation just to defend their basic rights.

That's why my team is working with pro-life legislators on the CARE Act, which includes multiple provisions that would protect pro-life pregnancy centers from targeted harassment and attacks. Last year, Montana became the first state to pass it last year, Wyoming and Kansas passed it this year, and several other states are working on it as well.

## **Step 3: Stop Mail-Order Abortion**
And we're dedicated to putting an end to abortion activists' end-run around pro-life state laws by pushing chemical abortion drugs through the mail. Since the Biden administration FDA dismantled critical safeguards that protected young women and girls, mail-order abortion drugs have become the most common method of abortion.

It's frightening to think that so many mothers are left to perform their own abortions at home or suffer coercion and abuse without even a single in-person office visit or plans for follow-up care.

Consider Rosalie, who was coerced by her former boyfriend to take chemical abortion drugs. He made her fear for her safety and demanded she take the drugs to end their child's life. She had no opportunity to ask for help--he ordered the drugs online from a California doctor who never even spoke with her.

"If mail-order abortion wasn't a thing, I'm 100% sure I would have my child," Rosalie said.

She's now working alongside the state of Louisiana and ADF to hold the FDA accountable for allowing the drugs that killed her child to be recklessly distributed through the mail.

Ending _Roe_ was a landmark moment in the decades-long effort to protect unborn life. But much work remains--and you can play a key role in protecting the lives that are "fearfully and wonderfully made."

---
[ **FLIP TX-03** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt87s-FAVnLi1GjFunqPMdDDvXf78d72uN-w4Q9eXo-RxgrZMLJyzT4bbAWqHtJ_IvmOMt2xcHN88TAhcufKdZWHY8GjdFY_SkHKEkkM40YxOhhZRhvUrg99umtRMJFnckRD-t_Eos06glRW7XZnkhQkXbH3CC7WAhmOigarCc4XIMTI0QpwVaAvT3oZ3RPFm5nEylrNuTuKDpO_k9L0XQUqww38Xtb93ko-7BAf6_U8Uw5MEFxlWSL3QShWNvq1_-7LcJq0IX4kWwWfbxAce7thuEwW_vnGkkDUAp0WwCEn_oljbLFzPMTxUPlnRCOjSLxw/4qd/VFIwvATYQ5KR6Yg1G3XWmw/h1/h001.tzieSjPvvVWTSoWuKX9mmN5KXd4h4gvhG0tBBnD7Zx0)

When I told my parents I was giving up law school to fly jets and go to war, they told me it would be hard on me and harder on my family. There would be little pay and greater costs and war was nothing like Hollywood makes it out to be. They were right about every word of it. **But what I did not know then was that 20 years in uniform would hand me something I never anticipated: a clarity about what actually matters when everything is on the line.**
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt87s-FAVnLi1GjFunqPMdDDvXf78d72uN-w4Q9eXo-RxgrZMLJyzT4bbAWqHtJ_IvmITxScLhRdvh-u2SlIOekLdWwWkogwN8JOYl-eJplz0X-a-daeh48Xqj-XDl7iX3Gx1VuH-l63PrKemBodLEzlXenJ2UodYw61KVOcm6iyaMwXPPW7hD67eFs7fgwxlzxPreSZ70eHlnnN1TScXoqoOelJyUH9HADJVVVMILzlJ0YxLYkbcfFFKLSr9Qt6S2rgrcum5xUZChdRSpYejY0HGDc0jb_xJPJdAk-wa_kdgoYHMs9koiBTXcie4LORyUEA/4qd/VFIwvATYQ5KR6Yg1G3XWmw/h2/h001.-ojQTKihAhncMIEwaJwQwnOJUVLi-p31U2mk8Mtn7ss)

My first commander told a room full of young aviators that you are what you do when it counts. Not what you say or what you promise, but what you actually do in the moment that requires something real from you. **I carried that into combat over Afghanistan and into the responsibility of commanding nearly 200 personnel, where the consequences of getting it wrong were ones nobody could take back.** [**If those values mean something to you the way they mean something to me, chip in today and help us take them all the way to Congress.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt87s-FAVnLi1GjFunqPMdDDvXf78d72uN-w4Q9eXo-RxgrZMLJyzT4bbAWqHtJ_IvmMq9AyCnQhvIoh6bi19Ny6Elq-5NpOW51FRC-pJLe3jzvpmk_eKpDCReGQ76HFgkQoH2rYZU57YOGFcj3VSzM23O8rKAIbRxhr3o2bzhTpFEMxLfUnFFP1OII-vC3DYBJYKaexqIo9PXY8dvORfEHttzKgac_TeHLr1CWvRP5cwFXz_gHNHmeXl9_rpu_9mexpA2V_IizKXva6MjZqtbnCEPFiOZKHCXsMBUYOmpzUSsTYejFdxX7lyUOkHEc1wIuw/4qd/VFIwvATYQ5KR6Yg1G3XWmw/h3/h001.AsHxk0bIu7VR-lRBYIN0k4wXb8S7K5vyhsObGmIE7F0) The military also taught me that service is never an individual endeavor. Every missed birthday and anniversary and holiday is a withdrawal from an account that the people who love you are keeping on your behalf. I owe my wife Courtney and my kids a debt that no rank or ribbon covers. P.S. If you’re waiting for things to magically fix themselves... don’t. That’s not how the real world works. This only changes if we force it to.

_**I sparked something.**_

If you’ve been paying attention to Los Angeles, you already know exactly what I mean.

This city has been burning for years. Not in headlines, in real life. Cost of living and crime out of control, leadership completely out of touch, and everyone in charge acting like it’s all normal.

It’s not normal. **It’s a disaster.**

[ ](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/7rB0O_IkSlFL_pzvKQBfcOXg1lqtK4ia2dFSf2PV636BjzunKtgLMFnOCoqLGFVscfq7OLIKoXXsywk1b3Fr7iTE7pP14HX59Qx0U9XN-yycS_HWdowEw6e86tYvN4sUGgmtcQi1X7O4FTY13o0RrYUvuYpz39SUzHS7C6CF9x9KPj6M9nUCJwr_Mv53U1gkLtJqspo7P8sSfrb2bqkxnW5E1xJPbVvBgU48C6cBEF4Om2q9_ityvX4oD-q35gpDHeu9bpsoQKcBqaNuBj7IFh8siQUc8dTzdkE0c9G-XKSSva7QTjRwXeb4Mvgdi00XM0SiFyUYNdZqCsA8E5sV7a-QZCvaTLo3zyD5pugXXHW72cuUZ4PsrtngvgOU23dIgmUYz18EM3Ua6HBO1KSC4Kkl8_sBxti0Xt1HXZs51etA2sDYlCe4zwPSLm6tWo8PpHkpYuqhLGFTb3L_7pXMiWbJnKDVYa6p0uz5xTHpYmJ7aYuYTzlASlh-iDF6lhp13ankZhclES07ykqRRx4VSA_YP-Oc9X0GJcSYsAk7Pqtovj5Z8ms20v6lCNmlgDvQtZibhyiC0hmn3ea8li7sdbsxFubEoCUEofDH-Ea5067sqzICXn8lfqZqE1cp1tOlKx36WNUjjDCRWgfNG_vMimxgYquodTX_Ahgs-QllZ_fbtfy1V9kFVjsji1Q0sA9MDyBKb3KK2Y6R/2oRZdX0tnVelccBVI9EgUdF2Zg9JITNE/20)

That makes people uncomfortable, _good._ **It should.**

I’m not running for mayor to blend in. I’m running to take this city back, fix what’s broken, and actually make Los Angeles livable again.

Years ago, I was a public school math teacher myself, so I can say from personal experience that being a teacher is one of the most demanding and rewarding jobs there is.
# [](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/12?t=1&akid=75%2E127862%2EtLwIpo)
Today is Teacher Appreciation Day, and I want to take a moment to celebrate the educators across Nevada who show up every single day for our kids.
Years ago, I was a public school math teacher myself, so I can say from personal experience that being a teacher is one of the most demanding and rewarding jobs there is.
[](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260505_1_ak.uep89n&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-73&t=2&akid=75%2E127862%2EtLwIpo)_My old yearbook photo._
Teachers show up early and stay late. They buy supplies out of their own pockets. They do everything they can to set our kids up for success.
But right now, teachers — and public education as a whole — are under threat from the highest levels of government.
**Donald Trump has made his plan clear: he wants to gut the Department of Education, and MAGA Governor Joe Lombardo backs this disastrous plan. It’s horrible.**
Nevada's classrooms are already among the most crowded and worst-funded in the nation. Our teachers are already stretched thin. This is the last thing our kids need.
**I’m running for Governor because our schools need a fighter, not a follower.** I'll invest in and protect our public schools, because I know firsthand what it means when our government shows up for kids. It changed my life. It can change theirs.
On Teacher Appreciation Day and every day, our teachers deserve someone in the governor’s office who has their backs. **[Will you chip in $5 today to help us get there?](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260505_1_ak.uep89n&amount=5&refcode=em20260505-73&t=3&akid=75%2E127862%2EtLwIpo)**

_**Cliff 's Note: An airline went bankrupt due to the price of jet fuel, and gas where I am is already over five bucks, but the orange diaper man wants to insist it's Biden's fault. It would be laughable, except why isn't corporate media talking about this? Oh, yeah, because their scared of Orange Shitler, despite his subterranean numbers. If you want to help support David Shuster telling the unvarnished truth, [please subscribe to BAM today!](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_
_**by David Shuster**_
There are few spectacles more nauseating these days than watching the Trump administration get caught flat footed by reality and proceeding, with great vigor and even greater absurdity, to deny that reality exists. But here we go again.
Because of the ongoing Iran war, blockages continue in the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical shipping lanes. In turn, oil and gas prices keep surging.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The inflation is spreading its contagion throughout the global economy, including in the United States. Higher fuel costs mean higher transportation costs, which means higher prices for everyday goods, including food. This is not mysterious. It is plain arithmetic.
But key figures in the Trump administration are desperately spinning and deflecting. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy recently blamed the latest Iran war economic casualty - Spirit Airlines -- on the Biden administration.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Duffy acknowledged to Fox News that jet fuel prices have gone up. But Duffy declared "Spirit isn't going out of business because of the Iran War. This story was written years ago because democrats blocked Spirit from merging with another airline."
Ugh no. Spirit Airline executives say they stopped operations because of "sustained and soaring jet fuel costs." To put it simply, Spirit cannot afford the jet fuel costs caused by the Iran war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As for the airline that Spirit considered merging with a few years ago, Jet Blue? Analysts believe Jet Blue will also go bankrupt if jet fuel prices don't drop this summer.
Trump agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins is also trying to blame the Biden administration for economic problems under her purview. Rollins told reporters that soaring beef prices are because the Biden administration "did everything they could to basically eviscerate the cattle industry, through grazing allotment, or climate change restrictions."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Rollins also pointed to wildfires in Nebraska and the screw-worm parasite which has forced the closure of some imports. In other words, the Secretary of Agriculture claims beef prices are rising not because of rising fuel costs, but rather due to factors beyond the Trump administration's control, including the Biden administration. Beef industry analysts call Rollins claims "ridiculous."
But it gets even worse. During her news conference, Rollins called climate change a "hoax." Then, White House economic advisor Peter Navarro stepped up to the same microphones and blamed higher inflation on higher beef prices caused by a decade long drought.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Navarro said there is nothing the Trump administration can do about drought, presumably because the Trump administration doesn't believe in climate change or any environmental downside of drill baby drill. The economic foolishness is clear. Renewable energy sources, including solar and wind, are now less expensive in many parts of the United States than energy powered by oil and gas.
So, thanks to the Trump, U.S. energy prices are costlier and inflicting a greater economic and environmental toll than if the Biden energy policies had been left alone.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To be fair, there are some republicans who are willing to acknowledge the connection between Trump actions and soaring prices for energy and food. John Rose is running for Governor of Tennessee.
He told Newsmax, "Yes gas prices are higher. But that's because the President decided we had to stop Iran from getting a nuclear weapon. So we are going to have to endure a little pain here. But you have to remember, we don't have gas lines in this country."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A little pain and no gas lines. Did you hear that? You may be paying five bucks a gallon for gasoline. But at least there is plenty of supply and no gas shortages, rationing, or long lines.
For the record, we have not had supply shortages and gas lines in the United States since 1979. That was 47 years ago.
What's missing from the GOP and Trump team responses is accountability to the present moment.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Leadership during economic strain requires acknowledging reality, even when it's inconvenient. It means explaining how international disruptions affect domestic prices, outlining steps to stabilize supply chains, and offering relief where possible.
The Trump administration habit of perpetual blame has consequences beyond mere irritation. It corrodes trust. If every present difficulty is forever the fault of the previous administration, then the logical conclusion is that no one now in office bears any responsibility at all. And if no one is responsible, then it follows that no one is in charge.
Thankfully, the American public has not been so easily duped.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/602beb16-58c6-4229-968f-0e34ff724599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Consumers feel the pinch at the pump, at the grocery store, and in the quiet recalculations of household budgets. Those of us who cannot recite the finer points of global energy markets, still know that something real is happening and getting worse.
A government worthy of our United States would address that reality with candor.
Instead, Trump and his administration officials and sycophants keep delivering a political show. It is loud, repetitive, and utterly unconvincing. Viewers watching these performances or clips from mostly conservative media, are not enlightened or reassured. And even conservative hosts guiding the interviews seem increasingly exhausted and faintly insulted.
This is the state of affairs under Trump. Rhetoric keeps displacing reason, the economic crisis continues, gas and food prices climb ever higher, and the explanations and excuses are growing more fantastical and absurd.

David Shuster on the most absurd round of administration gaslighting yet--from Brooke Rollins calling climate change a "hoax" to Peter Navarro blaming the drought he refuses to address. | | and | May 5 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Cliff 's Note: An airline went bankrupt due to the price of jet fuel, and gas where I am is already over five bucks, but the orange diaper man wants to insist it's Biden's fault. It would be laughable, except why isn't corporate media talking about this? Oh, yeah, because their scared of Orange Shitler, despite his subterranean numbers. If you want to help support David Shuster telling the unvarnished truth, by David Shuster There are few spectacles more nauseating these days than watching the Trump administration get caught flat footed by reality and proceeding, with great vigor and even greater absurdity, to deny that reality exists. But here we go again. Because of the ongoing Iran war, blockages continue in the Strait of Hormuz, one of the world's most critical shipping lanes. In turn, oil and gas prices keep surging. | | ---|---|--- The inflation is spreading its contagion throughout the global economy, including in the United States. Higher fuel costs mean higher transportation costs, which means higher prices for everyday goods, including food. This is not mysterious. It is plain arithmetic. But key figures in the Trump administration are desperately spinning and deflecting. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy recently blamed the latest Iran war economic casualty - Spirit Airlines -- on the Biden administration. | | ---|---|--- Duffy acknowledged to Fox News that jet fuel prices have gone up. But Duffy declared "Spirit isn't going out of business because of the Iran War. This story was written years ago because democrats blocked Spirit from merging with another airline." Ugh no. Spirit Airline executives say they stopped operations because of "sustained and soaring jet fuel costs." To put it simply, Spirit cannot afford the jet fuel costs caused by the Iran war. | | ---|---|--- As for the airline that Spirit considered merging with a few years ago, Jet Blue? Analysts believe Jet Blue will also go bankrupt if jet fuel prices don't drop this summer. Trump agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins is also trying to blame the Biden administration for economic problems under her purview. Rollins told reporters that soaring beef prices are because the Biden administration "did everything they could to basically eviscerate the cattle industry, through grazing allotment, or climate change restrictions." | | ---|---|--- Rollins also pointed to wildfires in Nebraska and the screw-worm parasite which has forced the closure of some imports. In other words, the Secretary of Agriculture claims beef prices are rising not because of rising fuel costs, but rather due to factors beyond the Trump administration's control, including the Biden administration. Beef industry analysts call Rollins claims "ridiculous." But it gets even worse. During her news conference, Rollins called climate change a "hoax." Then, White House economic advisor Peter Navarro stepped up to the same microphones and blamed higher inflation on higher beef prices caused by a decade long drought. | | ---|---|--- Navarro said there is nothing the Trump administration can do about drought, presumably because the Trump administration doesn't believe in climate change or any environmental downside of drill baby drill. The economic foolishness is clear. Renewable energy sources, including solar and wind, are now less expensive in many parts of the United States than energy powered by oil and gas. So, thanks to the Trump, U.S. energy prices are costlier and inflicting a greater economic and environmental toll than if the Biden energy policies had been left alone. | | ---|---|--- To be fair, there are some republicans who are willing to acknowledge the connection between Trump actions and soaring prices for energy and food. John Rose is running for Governor of Tennessee. He told Newsmax, "Yes gas prices are higher. But that's because the President decided we had to stop Iran from getting a nuclear weapon. So we are going to have to endure a little pain here. But you have to remember, we don't have gas lines in this country." | | ---|---|--- A little pain and no gas lines. Did you hear that? You may be paying five bucks a gallon for gasoline. But at least there is plenty of supply and no gas shortages, rationing, or long lines. For the record, we have not had supply shortages and gas lines in the United States since 1979. That was 47 years ago. What's missing from the GOP and Trump team responses is accountability to the present moment. | | ---|---|--- Leadership during economic strain requires acknowledging reality, even when it's inconvenient. It means explaining how international disruptions affect domestic prices, outlining steps to stabilize supply chains, and offering relief where possible. The Trump administration habit of perpetual blame has consequences beyond mere irritation. It corrodes trust. If every present difficulty is forever the fault of the previous administration, then the logical conclusion is that no one now in office bears any responsibility at all. And if no one is responsible, then it follows that no one is in charge. Thankfully, the American public has not been so easily duped. | | ---|---|--- Consumers feel the pinch at the pump, at the grocery store, and in the quiet recalculations of household budgets. Those of us who cannot recite the finer points of global energy markets, still know that something real is happening and getting worse. A government worthy of our United States would address that reality with candor. Instead, Trump and his administration officials and sycophants keep delivering a political show. It is loud, repetitive, and utterly unconvincing. Viewers watching these performances or clips from mostly conservative media, are not enlightened or reassured. And even conservative hosts guiding the interviews seem increasingly exhausted and faintly insulted. This is the state of affairs under Trump. Rhetoric keeps displacing reason, the economic crisis continues, gas and food prices climb ever higher, and the explanations and excuses are growing more fantastical and absurd. This is the kind of column corporate news won't run because the corporate parents share the predator class's interest in keeping you confused about why your grocery bill went up. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

A Growing Banking Risk Could Affect Americans With $50,000+ in Savings or Retirement AccountsDear Reader,

Something unusual is happening inside the U.S. banking system — and many Americans haven't heard about it yet.

In recent months, stress inside the financial sector has continued to build.

The government seizure of **Republic First Bank** sent another signal that certain institutions may be under increasing pressure.

According to research from **Klaros Group** , more than **280 banks and credit unions are currently experiencing elevated financial stress** , representing close to **$900 billion in assets.**

For Americans with meaningful savings or retirement funds, this raises an important question:

**How protected is your money if banking conditions become unstable?**

A Warning From Banking Analysts
Christopher Wolfe, Managing Director and Head of North American Banks at Fitch Ratings, recently explained:

_"Some banks could struggle to maintain required capital levels, and in certain cases, failures remain possible."_

While no one can predict exactly what will happen next, many experts believe the financial system may be entering a **period of significant transition.**
A Major Shift in the Financial System
Another major development occurred when the Federal Reserve officially ended its **Bank Term Funding Program on March 11.**

Some analysts believe this could accelerate structural changes within the financial system — including the eventual introduction of **central bank digital currencies (CBDCs).**

Research from Wells Fargo titled _"Central Bank Digital Currencies and the Future of Money"_ highlights how these technologies could reshape the way money moves through the global economy.

For savers and retirees, this raises an important question:

**What steps can you take today to help protect your savings if the financial system continues to change?**

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. | | Each year as the months get warmer, Oregonians and westerners hold their breath to see what kind of wildfire season they'll be in for. It used to be that we could count on a few wildfires to ignite in late August or September, and be gone by the time fall rolled around. But over the last ten years, wildfires have grown significantly bigger, hotter, more frequent, and more dangerous to fight. And instead of fires starting in August or September, fires have started igniting earlier each year. This year, Oregon and the West are in for what's promising to be one of the most devastating fire seasons on record. Our state is experiencing record-low snowpack. Much of our state received just 11% of its normal pack. Crater Lake has the lowest snowpack in recorded history. These numbers are going to make Oregon's severe drought even worse. But that's not all. Last year, Trump and DOGE took a wrecking ball to wildfire preparation and firefighting operations. He defunded the federal programs that help states like ours prepare for and fight fires. 1400 qualified firefighting personnel left the Forest Service in 2025 and have yet to be replaced. And, just recently, it was announced that the Trump administration has decided to "reorganize the Forest Service." This sounds innocent enough, but just like everything else Trump has his hands on, the reality is far more sinister. Trump is replacing high-ranking fire officials with political appointees to do his bidding. He defunded 57 research stations, dedicated to researching the impacts of drought and forest management on wildfire risk. Let's be clear about what this is: Trump is gutting the Forest Service, safety of our communities be damned. He's gutting the agency and public servants that work tirelessly each year to protect our communities from and help us prepare for wildfires, just weeks away from what's promising to be one of the worst fire seasons in modern history. This is like needing open heart surgery and a few weeks before your operation, learning that the hospital has replaced your heart surgeon with Hannibal Lecter. Simply put: Oregon and Western states don't have the resources or firefighters we need for the upcoming season. **Donald Trump and JD Vance set us up to fail, and I fear the consequences will be catastrophic.** In the meantime, I'm going to continue fighting tirelessly to make sure our state gets what it needs to prepare for wildfires this summer. You're so important to me - no, really.

If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have the incredible opportunity to serve our country that I have as Vice President.

As the America First movement continues to take on new challenges, I need to know that we're best representing you.

Please, take our survey as soon as you can so I can see your responses.

It will only take five minutes, but it would mean the world to me.

Sincerely,

JD Vance

Peter,
There’s a terrifying reality in the California governor’s race:
With less than a month until the primary election, if we don’t consolidate support now, two MAGA Republicans could lock Democrats out of the general election ballot.
**We need a Democrat who stands out from the pack.** I’m not like most people running for governor. I'm a single mom of three kids who fills the gas tank and pushes the grocery cart just like almost everybody else in our state — and most of all, I can take accountability and laugh at myself too.
**That’s why we made the decision to launch a new ad right now—to cut through the noise and make sure voters across California hear what’s at stake.[You can check it out here:](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260505_2_ak.vZ5Kuk&refcode=em20260505-41277&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41277%2E3422442%2EDnZdIO)**

I’m running to lower costs for working families and take on powerful interests that keep Californians stuck—but none of that matters if voters don’t hear our message before ballots are cast.
And right now, that means breaking through a flood of spending from corporate-funded candidates and a literal billionaire pouring money into this race.
That’s why we launched this ad. Now, we need to keep it on air for as long as possible. California media markets are among the most expensive in the country, and with only weeks left until the primary, every day counts.
I’m counting on supporters like you, Peter, to help us keep this message in front of voters when it matters most.
**[I’d be honored if you chipped in $5 today to help us keep this ad on air and reach as many Californians as possible before the primary?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260505_2_ak.vZ5Kuk&refcode=em20260505-41277&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=41277%2E3422442%2EDnZdIO)**

Katie

name: Jon Ossoff for Senate
subject: About Jared Kushner
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
_Peter,_
_In case you missed it over the weekend, we wanted to make sure you saw this message from Jon about Jared Kushner, Donald Trump Jr., Eric Trump, and the entire “Mar-a-Lago mafia.”_
_\- Team Ossoff_
\---------- Begin forwarded message ---------
From: Jon Ossoff
Subject: re: Jared Kushner
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
How much do you know about Jared Kushner, Peter?
Jared — Donald Trump’s son-in-law — has taken _billions_ from the Government of Saudi Arabia through his shady private equity firm.
And now, he's apparently leading American diplomacy in the Middle East while at the very same time asking Princes and Sheikhs across the Arab world for billions more!
It’s cartoonish.
And it's not just Jared getting in on the action...
A company owned in part by Eric Trump and Don Jr. has been pitching Gulf kingdoms on its drone interceptors during this war.
_The Financial Times_ reported, “Pete Hegseth’s Broker Looked to Buy Defense Fund Before Iran Attack.”
_Never before have we seen so little effort to hide so much corruption, Peter._
**The Mar-a-Lago mafia has taken American corruption to spectacular new heights. But corruption in America runs a lot deeper than Donald Trump.**
Because how does American politics really work?
It's coin-operated: money in, favors out.
It's been running on secret money, corporate money, billionaire money. _Citizens United_ was the worst court decision in modern American history. It's why Members of Congress don't listen to the people; they listen to their donors.
**And this corruption is why insurance companies get away with denying your claim for a procedure you needed to save your life.**
This corruption is why Big Tech’s still allowed to spy on us and track our every move and sell our private lives to the highest bidder. This corruption is why the ultra rich get tax cuts while you pay more for everything.
And beneath it all, a lazy, cynical expedience in Congress and in both political parties, serving donors and reciting poll-tested talking points with no higher purpose than winning the next election.
_But it doesn't have to be this way._
The United States is still destined for greatness, but only united will we meet the challenges and seize the opportunities of our time: to guarantee great health care for every American, to unleash an affordable housing boom and save our family farms, to make America the world leader on human rights and return nations to the path of peaceful coexistence.
**But none of this is possible without victory this November.**
***
When I first ran for Congress, it was because I saw that the election of someone so unfit for the Presidency was a danger to the country. And you got behind me because you saw the same thing.
When we won the Senate it was because we still understood together the urgency and necessity of the moment, and we knew Georgia could lead the way.
Now, the nation is once again turning to Georgia in a moment of crisis.
[**If you share my outrage at this unprecedented corruption and abuse of power — and if you are determined to WIN — please chip in to my campaign today. This is the most important Senate race in the country, and I can’t win without you.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-may26.KE07xH&refcode=em260505-2-subs&t=1&akid=2232%2E5691347%2Ed1ufRQ)
_If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_
| | **[DONATE $5](https://act.electjon.com/go/34?c0=ossoff-em-may26.hx6_OY&amount=5&refcode=em260505-2-subs&t=2&akid=2232%2E5691347%2Ed1ufRQ)**
---
****
| **[DONATE OTHER](https://act.electjon.com/go/34?c0=ossoff-em-may26.hx6_OY&refcode=em260505-2-subs&t=3&akid=2232%2E5691347%2Ed1ufRQ)**
---
****
Thank you so much,
Jon

Hi folks,
You don’t need a report to tell you the cost of living is still too high. You feel it every time you fill up your tank, pay your bills, or try to make ends meet each month.
And here in Colorado’s 3rd District, the pressure isn’t the same everywhere, but it’s hitting everyone.
In some parts of this district, housing costs have gotten completely out of reach. In others, families are trying to get by while wages haven’t kept up.
And when it comes to healthcare, the situation is even more serious:
* Nearly 1 in 4 people in this district rely on Medicaid.
* 82% of Western Colorado residents are worried about affording care.
* And too many are skipping care altogether because they simply can’t afford it.
That’s not sustainable. And it’s not acceptable.
We need leadership that actually understands what people are dealing with and is willing to do something about it.
That means lowering everyday costs, protecting healthcare access, and building an economy that works for the people who live here, not just the people at the top.
Together we can do that—but only if we win. Will you chip in $10 or whatever you can today to help us keep building a campaign focused on real economic solutions? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-ak&amount=10]

Beto’s been hitting the road hard lately.
Campuses. Community colleges. Student centers. Courtyards. Concerts. Anywhere we can find young Texans who are ready to talk about the future of this state.
And when he meets someone who needs to register, update their registration, or figure out how to vote, we make sure to get them ready to vote in November’s election.
It’s the best part of the work we do.
Powered by People has 13 organizers across Texas and hundreds of volunteers who are doing this every day.
They’re talking to young Texans, answering questions, checking registrations, and personally following up with voters until they cast a ballot.
Beto joins our volunteers on the road because these conversations matter. Our organizers and volunteers are out there because they know what’s possible when we reach people face to face and stay with them all the way through Election Day.
This work of personally connecting with and staying in touch with young voters produces big results. In 2024, the young voters we met in this way turned out at over 79%, compared to a state-wide average for young people of between 37-39%.

Republican Task Force Tuesday, May 5, 2026
Navy Sinks Seven Iranian Boats

The U.S. military [sank seven small Iranian boats](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDHOozAQRk9jOiMzYEgKF9vQZdst0WCPgxVjLHsI2j39KjnCX3_Sp_fen8fywBBDev7GnUxhv7jDLVzOPXu0VF_0l6lySCG5gGkBBaNUWiq9pLh0jTPOOuxsQ6abppuCvhvvzWb0gNYDrNSPK1ocSGl_83bVaLWH3jfBfK6UVhr67g5TC53y421QK04WpoHEoDBS4bZQPtcYLCbG-vJHsdTaY2-i2ZhzFf0vAbOA-bqu1q410VU_u4A5hjfJMztkqgLmUDDJC4v86snKBQPLw8vtKPv5T9YtZInMaF-St0LIMhNakrkc-agYBcxNMS5fIcZQx0kM6rljiF8c_kG9t4H_AQAA___8nILZ) Monday as part of Operation Project Freedom -- Trump's declared mission to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after Iran's naval blockade trapped hundreds of ships and their crews in the Gulf. Iran fought back, [launching drone and missile attacks](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOpDAQRL_GZEZ2AwYCByedkC6YSzdEjd3MWBiD7GZG-_er2WjjTatUpaf3cZtvGGJI9_-4k828zv7wM-drP1d0VDb6ZCocUkg-YJpBgZGqk6qbU5x15a13HrWryOq-HxQ02ozVw_q1HVZCPy6w0DiM2htyYMChc0unqQr2faU61UGjR-hr0Go1Q6sW7B30LYlWYaTMdabzWmJwmBjLth7ZUe2OvYr2wXwW0fwRMAmYcHGJXqW-H-9awPQvMeWEHI6EUcAUw5PkdXpkKgKmkDHJn5m8tp0Pmek8MheJzOi2IkGWRzjfC9FMwYvmr27AgOkGqLL15yvEGIrpRavuO4b4Dce_cPm08BUAAP__RqiFCA) on United Arab Emirates ports and tankers transiting the strait, claiming the American operation violates its month-long ceasefire with Washington. The attacks triggered emergency closures at UAE shipping terminals. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called the Iranian response ["international extortion"](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO6yAURL8Gd1hwscEpKF7jLq_d0roGnFwFYwtIvNmvXzmfsOVopBmd83WdrkiR0u0_rsHmukx-81PNz3Vf0IXyCO8aSqVEyROmCQRoLnou-inFSTbeeudRuiZYacwgQEl9ae724gcxODl7pYPT6NUglZemg8EYNWvfkD2nRC96UPICpgUpFj10YkbjwHSBdQJjyLXNYX_OkRymiuWxbNmF1m1rE-291r0w9Y_ByGA8jqNdtu8UjnL2DMZIr8DPzGD8IHHKmPiBmd-3vD5_eKkZqfIV37xrsvX7QTFS0YZ14rYixc9T_YOYl4XfAAAA__-TCnOt) and insisted the ceasefire is "not over" -- while the Navy continues escorting civilian vessels through the strait regardless of Tehran's objections. ★★★
SCOTUS Clears Louisiana Redistricting

The Supreme Court [ordered its Louisiana redistricting ruling](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOpDAQRL_GZKB2gw0EDi4hm0svRB67mWmNsZFtDu3fr9hP2KSiUtXT-_dYH5YDx9dfu5PJdVt98mvN535s1lH50FelUjly9GzjioC6BdWCWmNYZeONd95K15CR4zgB9lLPzds4OeOmaZg9gZ827RUokJMfpJI9atuwuadAgcJezjh2KGHT0wBPOzocBxID2EC5dpmO8xnY2Vht-WwpO-pc2ptg3rUeRfR_BC4Cl-u6uiMFruzSXRC4RLqKwOV-EriAumMQuJTzyLRT69KZaxvSyYVttG0mz6VmdpXjq93ZV8p7aQFm0DD1TTb-uDgELnoUA7x2y-GHpf5C3X-D3wEAAP__C6J8tw) to take immediate effect, letting the state redraw its congressional map before November's midterms -- a decision that could hand Republicans an additional House seat in a cycle where they need every margin they can get. The move sparked a sharp public dispute between Justice Samuel Alito and Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson, who [called the Court's speed unprecedented](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0DFu7CAUheHV4I4RXBuwC4rXuJvXprSu4XpMBoMFOFF2H02yg9SfdI70v92XO4YY0uM_HmRL2xaf_dLKdZwbOqpP-mpUW0gh-YBpAQGaC8WFWlJcZOetdx6l68hKY0YBvdRTt1uj-wmgVzQOpFbSgqQaZK-dVNuk_dAF-5oSSijo5QTmBlJsehzEisaBGYgNAiOVdit0XmsMDlPD-txycXRz-eii3Vs7K-v_MZgZzG2nPcT4MgZzoccVsYWcGMwuX6XxFVuLVBnMatS9nAyv11noIP7rGEPL_B3ds-bEY75CDZiQH3gymLti_fkZYgxVGzaIx4Hh56xrf-j2YeE7AAD__zhvfVc) and accused the conservative majority of rushing to give Republicans maximum time to redistrict before November. The Council on Foreign Relations [estimates the ruling could deliver Republicans an extra House seat](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOqzAQRb8GOtDgYEwKF6-hy2u3RIM9ECu2QeNhUf5-tfmEbW9xdc75eswPDDHk7T8msizr7Hc_C5_pWNFRedFbqEjIIfuAeVaghgZ0A3rOce5qb73z2LmabGfMCOrWDff6aZcOhh6U9wuagTSC7r2CdSQ9gtemr4P9vQINWt26uzKt6mAdxh4WNE6ZnqoeMBJLy3ScSwwOs2B5rTs7at2e6mifIkepbv8qNVVquq6rdSu3O2-VmpAluEilUtNGzO-E2ROHvDXypKacB1Oixu0nS4PZf9aPXApeiFNDkZyEPZearT-uEGMog6l62BKG-CGQPwT7tuonAAD__8shfEo) -- meaningful in a cycle where Democrats need only a handful of pickups to retake the majority and begin the impeachment proceedings they've openly promised. ★★★
Ohio and Indiana Vote Today

Voters in Ohio and Indiana cast [primary ballots today](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LGO8yAQBOCnwZ2jZW0gLij-xl3-9kprDeuEC8YIyEV5-1PyCFfPaD5pvi7LhUIM6fqfdralbYs__NLKY88bOa53fjWuLaSQfKC0IKDuQfWglhQX2XnrnSfpOrbSmDPgIPXU3Sz6YTAT0QQOFMI6SqkVjno9S2O0l12w7ylQoHCQE5oTStj0eYSVjEMzshiBIpd2KpwfawyOUqN6347i-OSOvYv21lquYvgncBY4U078rO9I4JzL8c2uVYEzR3YtHKn2b1HgvNOrV30uYafy6gvXR_wUu2J9foYYQ9VGjHDdKcQP1f7wzI_F3wAAAP__lX5xuA) in the first major midterm temperature check of the 2026 cycle, setting up Senate, governor, and down-ballot contests that will define the November battlefield. The marquee test comes in Indiana, where seven Republican state senators who [voted against Trump's redistricting push](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1ygzAUhE8jOjH6QQgKFWnonDYlI6QHfmMhmIcc4ttncG6QZostvtlvv27jzWPCvHz6FRyVeYxbHAs91332AY4HvAocBTPmiD6PSqiWC8OFGXMaZRVdDNHLUIGT1nZCadn21d1p0NHqJkrRyl5b3QYLs42TidpoodsK3YUSRhilZa9sraSY264Rk7dB2QZYI3wCKjXB_pwSBp-LPx7zRgHqsK1VcvdS9oPpD6YGpobzPOu8U73RwtRw0ZkahLmiYWrIP_yQ3Niu623P1PB25H9anu-Eq6cXJ4h4FMJQMC-coBBOz4Jb5ivGArRySBCuoiIX9xNTwqO1rBHL6jG9h5V__Pjt1G8AAAD__9HQgXQ) face his personally endorsed challengers. Trump demanded everyone be primaried -- tonight's results will tell GOP legislators in every state whether defying him carries a price. In Ohio, Vivek Ramaswamy is the heavy favorite to win the Republican governor's primary, while the Senate race features appointed incumbent Jon Husted facing [an already-contentious general election matchup](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2OozAQgJ8GOqOxMRAKF9fQ5dorkbHHZBT_INsJurdfkdW-wFbzSSN9-mb-3de7Jk9x_6sDqlzdapNda36Fw2mD5Yn_K5ZKkaIlHVcBYmQwMBjW6FfeWmWN1dy0qPg03UD0fJzbh9pAgt0czDMit_3Q80FICY6js_0MW0vqUsEAg-j5LKZOcHDjTcKmJyMmiY0E7THXLuPx2jwZHasuT5eywc6k0Hr1qPUoTf-nEUsjlvM8O7OViGe59o1YLmzE8mkOZCvmwNCjqZRiYUemoDNhYd-3aVaqrsgKxmukB6Uf3tMbc0yZmRT3jOWytlnZ4yTvqYxTI2EPmvwnrP7ij28lvgIAAP__nLiFCg) against Sherrod Brown, who is mounting a comeback bid for his old seat.
* * *
Trump's Indiana Loyalty Test

Trump backed primary challengers against seven Indiana state senators who blocked his redistricting push -- live tests of whether Make America Great Again (MAGA) can function as a [compliance operation](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLFuwyAURb8Gb7YAG3AGhi7e0rWjheGRPAVjC55r5e-rpOoPdLnLle7RuV_X-eowYb59uhVsoTiHLcxUjnWPzkN9wJOgEmbMAV2eJZe65arlas5pFk2wwQcnfANWGDNy2Qt9ae6WB93DwCGORgUPoMy4CH_R0S96GaJo0L6muOJK9uIiTScFj3oc-OKMl2YANnCXoFBXYD-WhN5lcvURt-Kh89vaJHsn2ivrP5icmJzO8-zyk3CF-uqZnF4EJieu_uKoTE6_Jq5NcMNKjo4CLSTwhFtu3-bdndbUFBv2E1PCqg0b-G11mN5g-sdP31b-BAAA__8HEXeq). The results tonight will set a precedent for every Republican legislature in the country.

★★★
Ohio Senate: Epstein Enters 2026

Ohio's Senate primary -- appointed Republican incumbent Jon Husted against a Sherrod Brown comeback bid -- [opened with Epstein-themed attacks](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD1uxCAUhE-DOyzAP6wLijTuNm1KC8Pz-u1isOA51t4-cqRcIM1opJFmRt_XfbpbDBgfn3YDk2mZfPIT5WPbF-ugvOBNUAgjRo82TkqonouOi26KYZKVN955K10FRmp9E6qR_VCtBmQHbmnmRvTgVTfYttHQyEHb3gPItkJzVYlOdKqRg9K1kmLpb62YrXZKt8BaYQNkqjPsxxzQ2Ui2vJaUHdQubVUwK9FeWPPB1MjUeJ5nHd-EG5QrZ2q8FpgaRfcnR2Fq3FNAQnfZtGLiBaIl4E9YlgxvDnshwMifaY18PQqB52WFnJPnc05nrFfaQpWN308MAUuvWSsem8Xwe4v-QfHbqJ8AAAD__1_5glw), signaling how the Jeffrey Epstein allegation has become a deployable political weapon in the 2026 cycle.

★★★
Trump's Redistricting Push

CNN documents Trump's push to [use redistricting to lock in House seats](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOhCAURb8GOw08QbSg2MZutt3SMPB0XgbQALNm_n7jfMI2t7nJuTn357bcLAVK27eNaHJdF7_7peZXPFbrsDzxXbFUSpQ82bQAh6HlquVqSWERjTfeeStcg0ZoPXLoxTA1D-MHqcU6KjEJaYWSUk9a94jaKy9H5xoyF4orrqAXE-gOBF-HUfK71Q60RCa5DZhrl_F43QM5m6otz3XPDju3xyaYR61HYf0Xg5nBfJ5n51K6OgbzRWcwc3WFZDAfe6BKrjCYP3rthjm_o00eM6Wt_ZhF8hVzbDGgq7Sn0mTjj5NCoDJoJvkWLYXPfP3HW78G_gIAAP__aA54Iw) ahead of 2026, pressing state legislatures to redraw maps. Combined with Monday's Supreme Court ruling, Republicans now have judicial cover and presidential pressure to maximize the gerrymander.

* * *
Farm Bill Clears the House

The House [passed the Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLESnCAURb8GOxx8oqwFRRq6TZvSecJDmUVwALOTv8-YT0hzy3vvOb_e6xtDDGn_iSfp0vzqsltbuc_Lo6X6oT-NagspJBcwrSBg5mLiYlpTXIfOaWcdDrYjPSj1EjAO89IdehR-lAqWl1KwTCNKD0JtnmgQkyTlu6CfKjGJCcZhAdXDIPz8kmJDZUFJYlJgpNL6Qte9xWAxNawfn4ul3uazi_po7aps_MHAMDC1ZftpOQXsc9kZmETfysDgXoK9Y7sLMTDPKgMjpickA3PkuxK_sFaq3GM5-RZi5NQOTDny66G3wRFvlGrIiYHpinbXN8QY6qyYFPuJIf771P5D4W8NfwMAAP__Jd6AKA), 224-200, after years of stopgap extensions. Fourteen Democrats provided the margin in a rare show of bipartisan farm policy -- the first full farm bill since 2018.

★★★
Senate Targets June Markup

Senate Agriculture Committee Chairman John Boozman says the chamber is targeting [late May or early June for a Farm Bill markup](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0L1ygzAQBOCnEZ0Y6fizCxVp6Jw2JXNIB75YEowk4uHtM-QRUm7z7c5-PaYHsue4fmIgk8oyuc1NJR1hX9BSftFZKBeOHB1jnEBBL1UnVTdFP-nKGWcdaluR0cNwU9Do_l49TT80OGsEsKBA64761qLqZoCbVr3Gis1FqU510Og7DDVotfS3Vs04WBhaEq1CT6nUifZj9mwxFsyvZUuWaruFyptnKXsWzYeAUcC4YAr75tmekd65Zu85bpxrcoeA8WoTMKpOwJgpYiFZMK1UOK7SXzHgKQmTP-X3EUkuW5IXKWf2XgZMr2MXMFbJuP194bkfRKvWgOz_9pR_3Pdj4DcAAP__mFp_lA). The timeline keeps pressure on both chambers while the Senate version faces its own fight over nutrition benefit levels.

★★★
Trump Objects to Senate Housing Bill

President Trump has [privately raised objections to a major Senate housing bill](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD2OrDAQhE9jMlDTYAyBg5eQzUs3RI1_ZlpjDLLNor39ijnCJhWV6lN9X4_lQRw4Pv_T5nQqfrG7XUo6t8OTcfntforLhSNHyxQXBBxqkDXIJYalray2xlJrKqdbpUbArh2m6qXVYEffTZ6MQktmnSb0K3XWkzXrKFXF-p4CCRK7dkLVYAt-GHtYSRlUvRM9UHCpNMkd5xrYUCyU335PxjVm36qgX6UcWXT_BM4C5-u6mmMPXNjsd0HgHN2VBc43SeAM8o5e4Pz5V2cXqbj6tZ-Z47NeOYQaYAIJOFRJ2-PiEDgPSvTw3IjDB1v-YOlb428AAAD__xvOdZs), potentially complicating what would be the largest housing legislation in years. Even legislation with strong Senate momentum can stall when White House enthusiasm cools.

Hi Peter, Thank you for supporting the Rob Lucero for Congress campaign. You're invited to join Rob on Saturday, May 17th for a special Fundraiser Reception in the Highland Park neighborhood of Los Angeles. This will be a great opportunity to meet Rob in person, connect with fellow supporters, and hear directly about the campaign’s next steps as we build momentum toward Election Day, which is only four weeks away. Incumbent Jimmy Gomez has been weakened by the revelations surrounding Eric Swalwell. Gomez is trying to convince people that he knew nothing about his best buddy Swalwell's unethical behavior. #
Peter,
There are only 2 weeks left to win the PA-03 Democratic primary, and the Rabb-mentum is SURGING!
Last week, our candidate Chris Rabb secured two more major endorsements from Justice Democrat Rep. Rashida Tlaib and the Democratic Socialists of America.
**Plus, he was joined by Hasan Piker in West Philly, where 200 people came out to rally and knock doors.**
[****](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260505-1-cr.JgDvx8&refcode=em20260505-37746&%3Bamounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=37746%2E1203867%2EvAnvUB)Photo Credit: Annie Wu
Like Hasan told the crowd,
_“This is a district that is +40 Dem. This is where we run up the numbers.**This is a district that we cannot allow to go to a Do-Nothing Democrat** that can't say what Israel is doing is a genocide. We need left populist politics in this country. Responsive politics that says no to corporate money, no to corporate donors, and yes to ordinary Americans like you. A politics that will center the working class."_
Unlike his establishment- and AIPAC-backed opponents, Chris is the only candidate in this primary who refuses corporate PAC money and loudly opposes Israel’s genocide and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians.
He’s not beholden to any lobby group, billionaires, or the out-of-touch leadership of the Democratic Party — he’s beholden to the working-class people of Philadelphia.

## ****
Dear Fellow American, Since the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women 's Health Organization_ decision, the states have been empowered in ways they haven't for half a century to take real action to protect life. But groups like Planned Parenthood haven't gone away.

They are as determined as ever to push abortion--in what the _New York Times_ called "filthy facilities" and even through the mail and push dangerous gender transition drugs on minors.

And they want YOUR tax dollars to fund it. To fund an activist organization with a track record of putting radical abortion and gender-identity politics over people.

But you aren't helpless. You can partner with ADF's Center for Public Policy to make a difference--to help save babies and give mothers real opportunity to choose life, in state after state. That's not just hyperbole.

We're working to put an end to Planned Parenthood's gravy train of taxpayer funding and protect pro-life pregnancy centers--and we're succeeding.

## **Step 1: Defund Big Abortion**
One important way that pro-life state legislators and governors can make a real difference is to turn off the spigot of money that Big Abortion groups like Planned Parenthood receive.

Remember--money is fungible. That's YOUR money being spent to end unborn lives.

Thanks to the Supreme Court's ruling in Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic last year, states are free to defund abortion businesses like Planned Parenthood.

Here's one reason why this should be a no-brainer: _Planned Parenthood isn 't scraping by--it's flush with cash_. From 2018 to 2023 alone, it pulled in $3.2 billion in direct public funding, on top of hundreds of millions it receives every year from private donations. Since 2022, it's been riding a fundraising surge, stacking up more than $2.5 billion in net assets.

And don't buy the "non-abortion services" argument: that money they receive from the government doesn't go towards abortion. Money is fungible. **Every tax dollar you hand over frees up more resources for pro-abortion politicking and performing more abortions.**

Enough is enough.

Planned Parenthood should not get another cent from the paychecks of hardworking Americans, including you.

[**When you make your first gift today**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3fd21fb5e8784e56a110656f6ef83ffc&_e=6afAM1P8d5GUO2wwMVkxgwYoJjLGhnNTOB2QH2mhiq-PTSe5YyQ7sS1DPsMUHPvsRVuAp-XhT5k6bAtiSSH6n3urz-FYykLt5pf4MCpGczZmU5zKy5tlKTbVNxSXlbgrz5AOYz2PHWofQilTZWZSmfpTcWBbcRi6kqskX7AfWX4Y8uNQge4ONqSFQjD5OprtKgmxRGOaRdZvRqiO07T3ngOwR0gnsLpfv203Djwmr3ag-FRmJTiO0nbY73f7mu9hBF7ZAY9MpIzAk2EXNe5ALRRJvN_orDqT7r8w_-0SrZNDQCXcUGsdSuGERuWEXgyqXU6cWDGki9ZLiiLH6IQNPGfH9S96jVhGk9LavQ8jPwBioCS8xjHAZ7Y6SzpsotooNVrk0nYiHiB8h8YV4vD_g_lWfl1AYfY5WYmpXXqsYJjLjMokEy-AF6_JSDxS4siDYydxB4mAwh3I9O29rIVHcgAdOxD4n_FftK7q_NfHKDDvaxCz4jWXO65VUyuVs6O6AcRvyrI7iQrzxbf_5Rcg_pmHEvw6TxREgF-qpIGsv-KMWmfsK2A5UHImg9StDL8X6QJetqdpdx9m-n_DUGTCaP9p-C5o3T5-LjblFHyTVGoN3-GYSypAY_VNwSvzPW9PF9l0WtW4IEmKMS1mBHZkwBwe4p2KMewwIS_DYwDY8Gd8Cbs-5BcZewd5HgyKDaCk),**you 'll be joining a team that is serious about stopping abortion and providing mothers with the support they need. Plus, your generosity will be MATCHED, dollar for dollar, as long as funds remain available.**
[**MATCH MY GIFT**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3fd21fb5e8784e56a110656f6ef83ffc&_e=6afAM1P8d5GUO2wwMVkxgwYoJjLGhnNTOB2QH2mhiq-PTSe5YyQ7sS1DPsMUHPvsRVuAp-XhT5k6bAtiSSH6n3urz-FYykLt5pf4MCpGczZmU5zKy5tlKTbVNxSXlbgrz5AOYz2PHWofQilTZWZSmfpTcWBbcRi6kqskX7AfWX4Y8uNQge4ONqSFQjD5OprtKgmxRGOaRdZvRqiO07T3ngOwR0gnsLpfv203Djwmr3ag-FRmJTiO0nbY73f7mu9hIc0R7uaF9VBMwzpDl3KA6DENLadfEl0hHFRlyYxGMx324VNmEPHcH8xRzhLOVMqS_FijnEtWmOSV4SpcNSc4GXcNRXjSIzvQ2M924_BKxtLYLi1nUVaspHAS04Om1zrHeh8eopyANNDWJUhMFyMOyYdbJtyaYsCdgjowEEelPEPCH5w16SPEznegoPACF0PcKp7JvWvzz1o73K6f3SOdlz9-YJ-H6vPDoynid4R4Sijc3b_1DKW5FEfbps7kTJM7cjTl6UHoUNvD8ABN8IPE6JWWnEInx9K8dBw2dAIccoUobnwItDqLhweoaGONeqpDADSXh2WeFRUfWIfpx2QbUoN2A0uBtlJVThA95J-cRr8Sej-MrZjGQ7b4WJ-wvFfbiVFRyoQxNlGSo3sM1fKcllJ8H5gSrqXTMPjyamQvrXMut2UvB04HHZFYi8OsyIFO)

States like Texas, South Carolina, Idaho, and Tennessee have already taken action to defund Planned Parenthood and other abortion businesses. We'll continue to ramp up our on-the-ground efforts to encourage other states to follow their lead.

## **Step 2: Protect Pregnancy Centers**
It's not enough to defund Big Abortion. We're committed to protecting pro-life pregnancy centers from government harassment and threats to their ability to serve their communities. They shouldn't be forced to endure time-consuming litigation just to defend their basic rights.

That's why my team is working with pro-life legislators on the CARE Act, which includes multiple provisions that would protect pro-life pregnancy centers from targeted harassment and attacks. Last year, Montana became the first state to pass it last year, Wyoming and Kansas passed it this year, and several other states are working on it as well.

## **Step 3: Stop Mail-Order Abortion**
And we're dedicated to putting an end to abortion activists' end-run around pro-life state laws by pushing chemical abortion drugs through the mail. Since the Biden administration FDA dismantled critical safeguards that protected young women and girls, mail-order abortion drugs have become the most common method of abortion.

It's frightening to think that so many mothers are left to perform their own abortions at home or suffer coercion and abuse without even a single in-person office visit or plans for follow-up care.

Consider Rosalie, who was coerced by her former boyfriend to take chemical abortion drugs. He made her fear for her safety and demanded she take the drugs to end their child's life. She had no opportunity to ask for help--he ordered the drugs online from a California doctor who never even spoke with her.

"If mail-order abortion wasn't a thing, I'm 100% sure I would have my child," Rosalie said.

clean_body: | | | ** Dear Fellow American, Since the Dobbs v. Jackson Women 's Health Organization decision, the states have been empowered in ways they haven't for half a century to take real action to protect life. But groups like Planned Parenthood haven't gone away. They are as determined as ever to push abortion--in what the New York Times called "filthy facilities" and even through the mail and push dangerous gender transition drugs on minors. And they want YOUR tax dollars to fund it. To fund an activist organization with a track record of putting radical abortion and gender-identity politics over people. But you aren't helpless. You can partner with ADF's Center for Public Policy to make a difference--to help save babies and give mothers real opportunity to choose life, in state after state. That's not just hyperbole. We're working to put an end to Planned Parenthood's gravy train of taxpayer funding and protect pro-life pregnancy centers--and we're succeeding. Step 1: Defund Big Abortion One important way that pro-life state legislators and governors can make a real difference is to turn off the spigot of money that Big Abortion groups like Planned Parenthood receive. Remember--money is fungible. That's YOUR money being spent to end unborn lives. Thanks to the Supreme Court's ruling in Medina v. Planned Parenthood South Atlantic last year, states are free to defund abortion businesses like Planned Parenthood. Here's one reason why this should be a no-brainer: Planned Parenthood isn 't scraping by--it's flush with cash. From 2018 to 2023 alone, it pulled in $3.2 billion in direct public funding, on top of hundreds of millions it receives every year from private donations. Since 2022, it's been riding a fundraising surge, stacking up more than $2.5 billion in net assets. And don't buy the "non-abortion services" argument: that money they receive from the government doesn't go towards abortion. Money is fungible. Every tax dollar you hand over frees up more resources for pro-abortion politicking and performing more abortions. Enough is enough. Planned Parenthood should not get another cent from the paychecks of hardworking Americans, including you. 'll be joining a team that is serious about stopping abortion and providing mothers with the support they need. Plus, your generosity will be MATCHED, dollar for dollar, as long as funds remain available. States like Texas, South Carolina, Idaho, and Tennessee have already taken action to defund Planned Parenthood and other abortion businesses. We'll continue to ramp up our on-the-ground efforts to encourage other states to follow their lead. Step 2: Protect Pregnancy Centers It's not enough to defund Big Abortion. We're committed to protecting pro-life pregnancy centers from government harassment and threats to their ability to serve their communities. They shouldn't be forced to endure time-consuming litigation just to defend their basic rights. That's why my team is working with pro-life legislators on the CARE Act, which includes multiple provisions that would protect pro-life pregnancy centers from targeted harassment and attacks. Last year, Montana became the first state to pass it last year, Wyoming and Kansas passed it this year, and several other states are working on it as well. Step 3: Stop Mail-Order Abortion And we're dedicated to putting an end to abortion activists' end-run around pro-life state laws by pushing chemical abortion drugs through the mail. Since the Biden administration FDA dismantled critical safeguards that protected young women and girls, mail-order abortion drugs have become the most common method of abortion. It's frightening to think that so many mothers are left to perform their own abortions at home or suffer coercion and abuse without even a single in-person office visit or plans for follow-up care. Consider Rosalie, who was coerced by her former boyfriend to take chemical abortion drugs. He made her fear for her safety and demanded she take the drugs to end their child's life. She had no opportunity to ask for help--he ordered the drugs online from a California doctor who never even spoke with her. "If mail-order abortion wasn't a thing, I'm 100% sure I would have my child," Rosalie said. She's now working alongside the state of Louisiana and ADF to hold the FDA accountable for allowing the drugs that killed her child to be recklessly distributed through the mail. Ending Roe was a landmark moment in the decades-long effort to protect unborn life. But much work remains--and you can play a key role in protecting the lives that are "fearfully and wonderfully made." In Christ,Matt Sharp Senior Counsel, Director of the Center for Public Policy Alliance Defending Freedom P.S.** The need to defend unborn life and uphold mothers didn't stop when Roe was overturned. | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**

Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. **They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**

Our **Freedom Strike Force** partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. **Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.**

clean_body: Children like Kristen are still waiting A rescue team changed Kristen's life. Another mission begins in Phoenix. | | | | | | GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE | | | Friend,No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there. Alone. There was no bathroom. Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex. Over. And over. And over. This is the reality of child trafficking. Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen's story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another "date." But instead...she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force. They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. Free. Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal. She took the first step toward healing. This rescue was possible because people chose to act. The Sound of Freedom Foundation exists to stop the sale of God 's children. Inspired by the film Sound of Freedom , the Foundation works around the world to prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children. Our mission is simple. To stop the sale of God 's children. And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our Freedom Strike Force partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues. | | | | | Children like Kristen are waiting. Let me start with something most of us instinctively know to be true.

And that is that running as a progressive in this country is never easy. You are often taking on the corporate establishment, the media establishment, and sometimes even your own party's political establishment.

But as progressives, we also understand something that most in the Democratic Establishment does not:

And that is that while it is essential that we defeat Trumpism and all its ugly and destructive policies, we need to do more. We need to elect candidates who have the guts to stand up to the wealthiest people on earth, not simply beg those people for money.

No more tinkering around the edges. No more status quo politics.

In the United States every man, woman and child can and must enjoy a decent standard of living. That’s what the American people want, and that’s what we have to deliver.

Last week, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee announced they are backing Randy Villegas' Democratic primary opponent. It is disappointing, but it is not surprising.

But as we have seen time and time again, from Maine to California, the backing of establishment Democrats is no match for when working class people stand up and get involved to elect candidates who will work to create a government and an economy that works for ALL, not just the 1%.
